name: Fluted Marble Side Table
description: A monolithic side table crafted from what appears to be burgundy marble with prominent white veining. The table features a distinctive fluted or scalloped cylindrical body, with both the top and base edges mirroring this organic, curved profile. The surface is polished, highlighting the natural patterns and rich color of the stone. Its robust, sculptural form suggests it functions as a decorative and functional accent piece.

name: Rustic Wooden Bar Stool with Scalloped Backrest
description: A rustic-style wooden bar stool featuring a dark brown stained finish and a distinctive scalloped backrest. It includes a striped, tie-on fabric cushion for added comfort, a lower footrest, and turned details on the finials and feet.

name: Contemporary Blue Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in bright blue faux leather or vinyl, featuring a grid-tufted seat and backrest. The sofa has open-frame armrests with upholstered top pads, supported by cylindrical polished metal posts. It stands on four slender, cylindrical polished metal legs.

name: Modern Velvet Upholstered Bar Stool with Armrests
description: A modern bar stool featuring a rust-colored velvet upholstered seat and backrest, with integrated armrests. It stands on four tapered black legs, connected by a brass-finished circular footrest.

name: Modern Modular Two-Tone Sectional Sofa with Channel Tufting
description: A modern modular sectional sofa featuring a two-tone upholstery design. The seating surfaces and backrests are upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric, while the integrated armrests and lower frame components are covered in a contrasting dark brown faux leather. The backrests exhibit subtle horizontal channel tufting, and the sofa is supported by sleek, dark-finished metal legs.

name: Walnut Geometric Media Console
description: A long, low rectangular media console crafted from dark wood, likely walnut, featuring a striking three-dimensional geometric pattern on its front facade. The design is modern and sculptural.

name: Rustic Dark Wood Dining Chair with Rush Seat
description: A dark brown wooden dining chair with a carved backrest and a woven rush seat, presented against a white background.

name: Vintage Wooden Side Chair with Cutout Backrest and Upholstered Seat
description: A vintage wooden chair featuring an intricately carved backrest with repeating open scrollwork and an upholstered seat in a light beige fabric.

name: Modern Solid Walnut Table with Sculptural Legs
description: A modern rectangular dining table crafted from solid walnut wood. The table features a tabletop composed of multiple planks, with a subtle seam suggesting potential modularity or extension. Its most distinctive feature is the sculptural leg design, where the thick, curved legs are seamlessly integrated into the underside of the tabletop, creating a fluid, contemporary aesthetic. The natural wood grain is prominent, and the overall design is minimalist yet robust.

name: Modern Oak Cane Back Dining Chair
description: A modern dining chair constructed from light-toned solid oak, featuring a woven cane backrest and an upholstered cream fabric seat. The chair has a sleek design with straight legs and a subtly curved back.

name: Modern Curved Wooden Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A modern dining chair characterized by its distinctive curved wooden frame, integrated armrests that flow from the backrest, and a dark upholstered seat.

name: Ornate East Asian Carved Drum Coffee Table with Mother-of-Pearl Inlay
description: A low, round table featuring a deeply carved, openwork drum-shaped base with intricate floral motifs, and a dark, intricately inlaid tabletop. The tabletop has a slightly raised, tray-like edge.

name: Dark Wood Turned Pedestal Accent Table with Black Stone Top
description: A tall, slender accent table featuring a round black stone top and a dark-stained, turned wood pedestal base. The base is composed of several stacked, bulbous and disc-shaped elements, leading down to a round, stepped foot.

name: Polished Chrome Conical Table Lamp
description: A modern table lamp featuring a polished metallic finish, with a conical base flaring upwards and topped by a wide, shallow conical shade.

name: Curved Walnut Lounge Chair
description: A low-slung lounge chair featuring a dark, rich walnut-stained wooden frame with elegantly curved armrests and legs, paired with light beige upholstered cushions for the seat and back.

name: Modern Walnut Pedestal Side Table
description: A modern, round wooden side table featuring a sculptural pedestal base in a dark walnut finish. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Contemporary Walnut Square Pedestal Dining Table
description: A contemporary square dining table featuring a walnut wood top with a distinctive veneer pattern and a central pedestal base, resting on a round metal disc.

name: Contemporary Metal Frame Loveseat
description: A contemporary two-seater loveseat featuring a minimalist design with a slim, light-colored metal frame and thick, comfortable upholstered cushions. The frame forms the legs, base, and integrated armrests. The seating includes a single seat cushion, two back cushions, and two smaller accent pillows, all upholstered in a light beige or off-white fabric.

name: Stackable Chrome Sled Base Office Side Chair
description: A modern black upholstered side chair with a chrome-plated tubular steel sled base frame, suitable for office or guest seating.

name: Woven Leather Sofa
description: A contemporary low-profile sofa featuring a distinctive dark brown woven leather upholstery. The design is minimalist with integrated arms and backrest, creating a seamless and rectilinear form.

name: Contemporary Curvilinear Velvet Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in dark purple velvet, featuring a distinctive undulating backrest and integrated, rounded armrests. The design has a low-profile, seamless appearance.

name: Modern Outdoor Lounge Armchair
description: A modern lounge armchair featuring a white, open-frame structure and plush, light grey fabric cushions for both the seat and backrest. The design is simple, clean, and rectilinear, suitable for both indoor and outdoor contemporary settings. The frame consists of sturdy, flat planks forming the legs, armrests, and back support, while the cushions appear thick and comfortable.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Vanity Stool
description: A compact, contemporary upholstered vanity stool or accent chair featuring a rounded seat and a low, curved backrest, supported by thick, splayed wooden legs.

name: Wooden Side Chair with Woven Rush Seat and Carved Backrest
description: A wooden side chair featuring a woven rush seat and a distinctive circular carved backrest. The frame is crafted from dark, reddish-brown wood, with the front leg exhibiting a unique reeded detail near the foot. The rear legs are gently tapered and slightly splayed for stability. The backrest is a prominent design element, featuring a concentric spiral carving.

name: Modern Upholstered Swivel Accent Chair
description: A modern, round upholstered chair featuring a drum-shaped base and a low, curved backrest. The main body is covered in a light grey textured fabric, while the backrest and base are finished in a smooth, light beige material, likely faux leather.

name: Textured Fabric Organic Modern Lounge Chair
description: A single-person seating unit, fully upholstered in a textured fabric, featuring a high, curved backrest, integrated armrests, and a rounded base. It is accompanied by a small, rectangular lumbar pillow.

name: Contemporary Light Grey Fabric Loveseat
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa, commonly known as a loveseat, upholstered in a light grey textured fabric. It features clean, minimalist lines with gently curved armrests and rests on slim, tapered legs, likely made of metal or dark wood.

name: Sculptural Wavy Wooden Bookshelf
description: A tall, narrow bookshelf featuring a distinctive sculptural design with undulating, wavy side panels crafted from dark-toned wood. It has four horizontally aligned shelves and a back panel made from a lighter-toned wood, creating a visual contrast. The unit appears freestanding, blending organic forms with functional storage.

name: Round Fluted Wood Accent Table
description: A small, round accent table featuring a flat, light wood top with a subtle grain pattern. The table's distinctive base is cylindrical, constructed from numerous vertical, slender wooden dowels or slats, creating a prominent fluted or reeded texture. The entire piece is finished in a natural, light wood tone.

name: Distressed Leather Swivel Office Chair
description: A classic executive-style office chair upholstered in light brown distressed leather. It features a high back, sloped and padded armrests, and a deep seat, all covered in the same tactile leather. The chair rests on a five-star base made of distressed light-colored wood, equipped with dark casters featuring brass accents, allowing for easy mobility. The visible swivel mechanism indicates functional adjustability.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Bench with Brass Frame
description: A contemporary bench featuring a long, capsule-shaped upholstered seat covered in a light, textured boucle-style fabric, supported by a slender golden metal frame with four thin legs.

name: Modern Modular Dark Gray Leather Sofa with Tufted Backrest
description: A contemporary modular sofa upholstered in dark gray leather, featuring a subtly tufted backrest and wide, rounded track arms. The sofa comprises two distinct sections, supported by a low-profile base with dark, minimalist feet. Two matching loose throw pillows are included.

name: U-shaped Modular Boucle Sectional Sofa
description: A large, U-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in a cream-colored boucle fabric. It features a modular design with multiple sections, including chaise ends on both sides and a series of back cushions. The sofa has a low profile with wide, comfortable seating and rounded, integrated armrests.

name: Oval Travertine Coffee Table with Sculptural Walnut Base
description: An oval coffee table featuring a light-colored travertine stone top and two sculptural, dark-stained wooden bases. The bases are thick and arched, supporting the substantial stone slab.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair with Curved Back
description: A modern dining chair featuring a unique curved backrest that seamlessly transitions into integrated armrests, fully upholstered in a light brown or taupe textured bouclé fabric. The seat cushion is also upholstered in the same material. The chair is supported by four slender, tapered legs crafted from dark-stained wood.

name: Large Black Marble Arched Floor Mirror with Sculpted Columnar Frame
description: An oversized, floor-standing arched mirror featuring a dramatic frame made from black marble with striking white veining. The frame consists of a prominent arch supported by two substantial columnar uprights. These uprights are intricately sculpted with stacked, rounded segments at their bases and tops, transitioning into blockier rectangular sections in between. The entire piece rests on a wide, solid marble base. The mirror's reflective surface is clear, offering a full-length view and enhancing the sense of space.

name: Modern Modular Sectional Sofa Set with Integrated Tables and Ottomans
description: A contemporary modular sectional sofa set featuring a light beige textured upholstery, low profile design, and soft, rounded edges. The set includes a multi-piece sectional sofa, two integrated dark brown tabletops, and two matching upholstered ottomans, all resting on a subtle, raised base.

name: Beige Channel Tufted Divan Bed with Storage and Mattress
description: A complete bed unit comprising a beige upholstered divan base with two integrated storage drawers, a matching tall channel-tufted headboard, and a white and black mattress.

name: Modern Brass and Fabric Bolster Chaise Lounge
description: A modern and sculptural chaise lounge featuring multiple horizontal bolster cushions upholstered in a light beige fabric, resting on a sleek, curved metal base with a brushed brass finish. One end has an additional, slightly larger bolster cushion positioned vertically to serve as a headrest or armrest.

name: Modern Round Pedestal Dining Table
description: A modern round dining table featuring a sleek, monochromatic design with a circular tabletop supported by a single, wide conical pedestal base, all finished in a matte beige color.

name: Industrial Modern Metal and Faux Marble 4-Tier Shelving Unit
description: A contemporary four-tier shelving unit featuring a sturdy black metal frame and white faux marble shelves. The design is open-backed and minimalist, with a distinctive top section that includes a partial shelf, suggesting a modern or industrial aesthetic. The shelves provide ample storage or display space.

name: Modern Curved Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A contemporary platform bed featuring a generously curved headboard and footboard, fully upholstered in a dark navy blue fabric. The integrated base sits low to the ground, supported by subtle, light-toned round wooden feet.

name: Modern Wooden Platform Bed with Cane and Upholstered Headboard
description: A contemporary low-profile platform bed featuring a light-toned wooden frame and a distinctive headboard. The headboard combines a top section of natural cane webbing with lower vertically paneled upholstered sections in a neutral gray fabric. The bed is styled with light-colored bedding, including a textured quilt and a selection of decorative throw pillows.

name: Rectangular Dark Wood Coffee Table with Lower Shelf and Brass Accented Legs
description: A rectangular coffee table constructed from dark-stained wood, featuring a solid top surface, an integrated lower shelf for storage, and four tapered block legs adorned with polished brass caps at the base.

name: Mid-Century Modern Wooden Frame Two-Seater Sofa
description: A mid-century modern style two-seater sofa featuring an exposed dark wooden frame with clean lines. It has light beige upholstery on the back and seat cushions, which are rectangular and well-defined. The sofa includes open wooden armrests and tapers down to four solid wooden legs, showcasing a minimalist and functional design.

name: Modern Upholstered Chaise Lounge
description: A sleek, modern chaise lounge featuring grey upholstery, a low backrest, and a single armrest on the left side, supported by a minimalist black metal frame with tapered legs. It comes with two decorative pillows and a plaid throw blanket.

name: Traditional Tufted Leather Dining Armchair
description: This is a traditional style armchair featuring a solid wood frame with an upholstered seat and a deeply tufted backrest. The upholstery appears to be a reddish-brown leather or faux leather, secured with individual nailhead trim along the edges of the seat and the back panel. The wooden frame has turned arm supports and decorative carving on the top rail of the backrest. The front legs exhibit a gentle S-curve (cabriole-like) shape, while the back legs are straight, connected by stretcher bars.

name: Modern Black Leather Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A modern platform bed featuring a low-profile design and complete black leather upholstery. The headboard is padded and appears to be split into two sections, contributing to a comfortable, relaxed aesthetic. The bed frame extends flush with the mattress, supported by discreet, slender metal feet, giving it a floating appearance. The bedding consists of white pillows and a light gray duvet.

name: Neoclassical Tufted Dining Chair
description: A Neoclassical style dining chair featuring a carved wooden frame, dark button-tufted upholstery on the backrest, and a matching upholstered seat. The chair is accented with gold trim and brass nailhead detailing along the edges of the upholstery. The backrest has an ornate, curved top, and the legs are tapered.

name: Traditional Tan Leather Two-Seater Sofa
description: A traditional two-seater loveseat upholstered in supple tan leather, featuring plush, overstuffed seat and back cushions, and gently rolled arms. The design emphasizes comfort and a classic aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Dark Green Leather Three-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in dark green leather, featuring three plump seat cushions and three matching back cushions. It has rounded, rolled armrests and a base that rests on low, dark block feet.

name: Wooden Kids Learning Tower
description: A light-toned wooden structure designed to safely elevate a child to counter height. It features two steps for easy climbing, an enclosed top platform with horizontal safety rails, and a metal latch mechanism on one side that suggests it might be foldable or adjustable. The design is simple, minimalist, and functional, with cut-out handholds on the side panels.

name: Contemporary Wood Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a solid wood frame with a rich, warm brown finish. Both the seat and the backrest are upholstered in a dark gray, textured fabric. The backrest has a gently curved top edge, complementing the straight lines of the frame and legs. The chair is designed with a simple, functional aesthetic, suitable for modern interior settings.

name: Round Boucle Wood Ottoman
description: A contemporary round ottoman featuring a plush, off-white boucle fabric cushion set within a curved light wood frame. The wooden frame acts as both a base and partial enclosure for the upholstered top, creating a modern, sculptural aesthetic.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Panel Bed Frame
description: A dark wood bed frame featuring a tall, arched headboard with decorative carved trim and recessed panels, a matching footboard, and sturdy side rails supporting an integrated slat system for mattress support. The wood has a rich, dark brown finish.

name: Curved Contemporary Loveseat
description: A contemporary loveseat featuring a sleek, fully upholstered design with gracefully curved arms and an integrated backrest. It is finished in a light beige, textured fabric and comes with two matching throw pillows and one accent pillow with a geometric pattern. The loveseat has a compact, modern silhouette with a subtle, low profile and a clean, streamlined base.

name: Two-Part Modular Oak Wood Shelving Unit with Bottom Cabinets
description: This is a tall, two-part modular shelving unit crafted from light-toned oak wood, featuring a subtle wood grain. Each section has three open shelves above two closed cabinets. The top shelf of each section has distinctive raised side and back edges, creating a tray-like appearance. The cabinet doors are flush, with small circular handles, and appear to be either hinged or on sliding tracks. The overall design is minimalist and contemporary, with clean lines. The unit rests on a recessed plinth base.

name: Burgundy Velvet Upholstered Platform Bed with Scalloped Headboard
description: A luxurious platform bed featuring a distinctive scalloped headboard and fully upholstered in a plush burgundy velvet. The low-profile frame supports a mattress, and the bed is dressed with beige bedding, complemented by burgundy and light beige throw pillows and a burgundy blanket. The headboard's design consists of vertical, rounded fluted panels, giving it an Art Deco-inspired or glamorous contemporary aesthetic.

name: Mid-Century Modern Red Leather Armchair
description: A stylish Mid-Century Modern inspired armchair upholstered in rich red leather. The chair features a comfortable, rounded silhouette with broad track arms and a slightly reclined back. It stands on four slender, tapered dark wood legs that splay slightly, giving it a light and elegant appearance. The seat cushion is loose, and the overall construction suggests a compact yet inviting form.

name: Modern Three-Seater Fabric Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a teal blue fabric. It features a streamlined silhouette with square track arms and three individual seat cushions. Three matching back cushions provide support, and the entire piece is elevated by subtle, dark block feet.

name: Contemporary Black Faux Leather Armchair with Bentwood Accents
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a curved back and seat upholstered in black faux leather, complemented by bentwood armrests and splayed legs in a rich, warm wood tone. The design incorporates an open space between the backrest and seat, creating a visually light and modern aesthetic.

name: Sculptural Wood Pedestal Dining Table
description: A contemporary round dining table featuring a rich, dark wood finish on both its circular top and its distinctive sculptural pedestal base. The base is composed of two interweaving, curved wood elements that provide stability and a modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Fabric Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige, finely woven fabric. It features wide, squared track arms, two large seat cushions, and two large back cushions. The sofa rests on small, dark, recessed block feet. It is accessorized with four throw pillows, two solid beige and two with a brown, grey, and white wavy pattern.

name: Modern Upholstered Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame
description: A modern upholstered armchair featuring a rounded back and arms that flow into a cohesive form. The chair is covered in a light beige textured fabric, complemented by a single dark brown accent cushion. An exposed dark wood frame extends from the sides, forming the back support and tapering into the legs. Subtle brass-toned metal accents are integrated where the wooden frame meets the upholstered body, adding a touch of contemporary elegance. The overall design suggests comfort combined with refined aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Tan Leather Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a cohesive, gently curved shell for the backrest and integrated armrests, upholstered in a smooth, tan-colored leather. The seat cushion is also upholstered in matching leather. The entire upholstered body appears to rest upon a dark-finished, possibly metal or wood, exposed frame with four tapered legs.

name: Brown Faux Leather Cantilever Office Chair
description: A modern cantilever office chair featuring brown faux leather upholstery and a chrome-plated steel frame. The chair includes a high, ergonomically curved backrest and padded armrests, providing comfortable support. Its sleek design makes it suitable for contemporary office or conference room settings.

name: Dark Wood Round Coffee Table with Stacked Cylindrical Legs
description: A dark-stained wooden round table featuring a tray-like top with a slightly raised edge. The table is supported by numerous short, thick legs, each constructed from multiple stacked cylindrical wood sections, giving a textured, fluted appearance. The legs are symmetrically distributed around the perimeter of the circular top.

name: Mid-Century Modern Dining Chair with Boucle Upholstery
description: A stylish mid-century modern dining chair featuring a sculpted wooden frame and off-white boucle upholstery. The chair's frame is made from warm-toned wood with elegantly curved back supports and tapered legs. Both the seat and the organically shaped backrest are generously padded and covered in a textured, soft boucle fabric, providing a comfortable and visually appealing seating option. The design emphasizes organic forms and natural materials, typical of Scandinavian and mid-century aesthetics.

name: Modern Pedestal Accent Table
description: A modern pedestal accent table featuring a round top with a distinctive swirled pattern, supported by a slender central stem, and anchored by a complementary round, flared base. The base and stem exhibit a rich bronze-toned metallic finish, contrasting with the lighter, possibly stone-look or composite material of the tabletop.

name: Contemporary Curved Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a distinctive curved, armless design. The seating and backrest are upholstered in smooth, olive-green material, likely leather or faux leather, with prominent stitching. The base of the sofa contrasts with a dark green, intricately textured or woven material.

name: Industrial Two-Tiered Stainless Steel Service Cart
description: A professional-grade, two-tiered service cart constructed from brushed stainless steel. It features an open frame with vertical bar railings on all sides, two robust flat shelves, and a partial divider on the upper shelf. The unit is equipped with four swivel casters for easy mobility.

name: Bentwood Settee with Cane Seat and Fan Back
description: A classic two-seater bentwood settee featuring a dark wood frame, a woven cane seat, and an intricately designed fan-back rest. The settee has elegantly curved armrests and four tapered legs, characteristic of traditional bentwood craftsmanship.

name: Wooden Cane Lounge Chair
description: A vintage or Mid-Century Modern lounge chair constructed from a solid wooden frame with woven cane panels for the seat and backrest. The chair features a reclined back, wide, flat armrests, and robust, splayed legs. The wood exhibits a warm, medium brown tone, and the cane weaving is in a traditional open-mesh pattern. The overall design emphasizes a relaxed, comfortable posture.

name: Sculptural Wavy Wood Floor Lamp with Drum Shade
description: A floor lamp featuring a tall, sculptural base crafted from solid wood, characterized by a prominent wavy or serpentine silhouette. It is topped with a neutral-colored cylindrical drum lampshade, providing ambient light. The wood has a dark, natural finish.

name: Contemporary Square Two-Tiered Coffee Table with Glass Top
description: A contemporary square coffee table featuring a two-tiered design. The top surface is clear glass, framed by a dark, possibly black-stained wood with gently rounded corners. Below this, a solid dark wood shelf, matching the top frame's finish and rounded corners, serves as the lower tier. The structure is supported by slender, dark-finished metal legs that elegantly connect the upper frame and lower shelf, extending to the floor.

name: Oriental Rosewood Display Stand
description: A low-profile, circular display stand or pedestal table crafted from dark wood, likely rosewood or mahogany. It features an inset top panel, a curved apron, and four short, thick legs with a slightly splayed design, reflecting traditional East Asian furniture aesthetics. The wood has a rich, reddish-brown hue and a smooth, polished finish.

name: Contemporary Boucle Lounge Chair with Integrated Curved Backrest
description: A contemporary lounge chair upholstered in a textured cream boucle fabric. It features a unique design with a continuous, integrated curved backrest that wraps around the seating area, forming a partial armrest. The chair has a compact, armless base and a subtle piping detail along the edges of the curved backrest.

name: Modern Retail Display Shelf Unit with Integrated Lighting
description: A modern, free-standing retail display unit characterized by a bold blue frame and white shelving and cabinet components. It features two open display shelves, a lower three-door storage cabinet with rounded corners, and an illuminated header panel. The design is sleek and contemporary, optimized for commercial product presentation.

name: Two-seater Cane Webbing Sofa with Wood Frame
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring a light-toned wooden frame with rounded edges, cane webbing back and side panels, and comfortable, removable white fabric seat and back cushions. The sofa stands on slender, tapered wooden legs.

name: Round Slatted Wooden Folding Outdoor Table
description: A round, slatted wooden table designed with a folding X-frame base, suitable for outdoor use. The tabletop features an octagonal outer rim with horizontally aligned slats in the center. The wood has a warm, reddish-brown hue, indicating it is likely a weather-resistant timber like acacia or teak. Its folding mechanism allows for compact storage and portability.

name: Modern Rectangular Extendable Dining Table
description: A modern, rectangular dining table featuring a dark, possibly extendable, tabletop and distinctive angled, tapered legs. The table exhibits a minimalist design with clean lines and a dark wood finish.

name: Traditional Curved Back Spindle Side Chair
description: A vintage-style wooden side chair with a curved top rail backrest and vertical spindles, integrated short arm extensions, and straight legs. The seat is solid wood with a dark finish. The chair is made from a warm medium-brown wood.

name: Rectangular Labradorite and Concrete Coffee Table
description: A contemporary rectangular coffee table featuring a striking dark labradorite stone top with iridescent blue, green, and gold flecks, supported by two robust, rectangular concrete pedestal legs. The table exhibits a minimalist and brutalist aesthetic, highlighting the natural beauty and raw texture of its materials. The edges of the tabletop are gently rounded.

name: Natural Wood Children's Bunk Bed
description: A light natural wood bunk bed designed for children. It features a straightforward, rectangular frame with two stacked sleeping platforms. Each bed includes slatted guardrails for safety, with the top bunk having a full set of rails on all open sides, and the bottom bunk having a partial rail at the foot. An integrated ladder with flat steps is built into the side frame, providing access to the top bunk. The wood grain is visible, suggesting a light-colored solid wood construction, and the overall design is simple and functional. Both bunks are fitted with plain white mattresses.

name: Mid-Century Modern Multi-Arm Chandelier with Sculptural Shades
description: A ceiling-mounted chandelier featuring a central brass downrod extending to a multi-arm structure. The frame consists of several gracefully curved brass arms, each terminating in a light socket with an exposed bulb. Each light source is accompanied by a distinctive, organically shaped, cream-colored shade that partially encloses the bulb, directing light and adding a sculptural element to the fixture. The overall design suggests a Mid-Century Modern aesthetic.

name: Wall-Mounted Fluted Wood Bathroom Vanity with Integrated Sink and Matte Black Faucet
description: A modern wall-mounted bathroom vanity featuring a rectangular integrated white ceramic sink and a contemporary matte black single-handle faucet. The vanity cabinet is constructed from a rich, warm-toned wood, likely walnut or a similar veneer, with a distinctive fluted or reeded texture across its front surface. It includes two pull-out drawers with sleek, recessed black handles that blend into the design. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and sophisticated, designed for a clean, floating appearance.

name: Modern Bentwood Dining Armchair with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A modern dining armchair featuring a light-toned solid wood frame with elegantly curved back and armrests, and a distinct sled-style base. It includes a beige upholstered seat cushion and a matching upholstered back support.

name: Round Two-Drawer Wood Nightstand with Nailhead Trim
description: A round, barrel-shaped nightstand featuring two drawers, crafted from wood with a warm, rich brown finish. It is intricately detailed with bands of brass nailhead trim along the top, mid-section, and base. Each drawer is fitted with a singular, elongated brushed metal pull handle.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed
description: A low-profile contemporary platform bed featuring a fully upholstered frame with rounded corners, topped with a mattress, white bedding, and layered blankets.

name: Contemporary Rounded Wood and Bouclé Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a distinctive rounded wooden frame that cradles a deep, upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery is a textured burnt orange fabric, complemented by a strip of dark blue fabric on the inner back. Brass accents include a large circular pivot point connecting the frame to the legs and a curved rod detail along the back.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a sculptural form with a dark brown upholstered seat and backrest, cradled by an exposed dark wood frame that forms the armrests and legs. The fabric appears textured, and the wooden elements have a smooth, polished finish, contributing to an elegant and modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in a cream-colored bouclé fabric. It features a minimalist design with wide, rounded track arms and a low-profile silhouette. The sofa has two distinct seat cushions and two matching back cushions, providing a clean, inviting look.

name: Modern Armless Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A low-profile armless lounge chair featuring a distinctive dark, glossy wooden frame and plush brown upholstered cushions. The design emphasizes comfort with thick, rounded seat and back cushions that appear to float within the rigid frame. The frame itself has a sculptural quality, providing structural support and subtly integrated armrests.

name: Sculptural Wave-Textured Accent Chair
description: A striking black accent chair featuring a unique, wave-textured surface that gives it a fluid, sculptural appearance. The chair has a solid, monolithic form with a high back and a distinctive draped 'skirt' design extending to the floor, creating a sense of movement. The entire piece is rendered in a uniform dark tone, emphasizing its intricate texture and contemporary silhouette.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Four-Poster Bed Frame
description: A traditional four-poster bed frame crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring prominently turned posts at each corner and a solid, slightly curved headboard. The bed is dressed with light-colored bedding, including a mattress, two pillows, a duvet, and a pale green throw blanket draped across the foot of the bed. The frame is substantial, indicating a durable construction style.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Chaise Lounge Sectional Component
description: A side profile view of a contemporary brown upholstered chaise lounge, likely a component of a larger sectional sofa. It features deep seating, integrated low-profile arms, and a backrest with distinct vertical channel tufting. The upholstery appears to be a soft fabric, possibly velvet or microfiber, in a rich chocolate brown hue. The base is simple with minimal block feet, suggesting a modern and grounded aesthetic. Overlaid measurements indicate a seat depth of 30 inches and an overall diagonal length of 57.2 inches, providing context for its proportions.

name: Mid-Century Style Cane Back Armchair

description: A modern armless side chair featuring a sleek red fabric upholstered seat and back, supported by a minimalist black metal sled base frame. The design emphasizes clean lines and functional simplicity.

name: Upholstered Cantilever Dining Chair
description: An armless dining chair featuring a polished chrome cantilever frame and cream-colored upholstered seat and backrest. The design is minimalist and modern, with rounded, padded cushions.

name: Contemporary Channel Tufted Accent Chair
description: A contemporary grey upholstered accent chair with a rounded, bucket-style seat and backrest featuring horizontal channel tufting, supported by four slender splayed black metal legs.

name: Woven Rattan Outdoor Storage Chest on Casters
description: A rectangular outdoor storage chest featuring a woven rattan-look exterior, a hinged lid secured by a metal clasp, integrated black handles on the short sides, and four black caster wheels for mobility. The chest has a natural light brown color and a clean, contemporary design suitable for outdoor use.

name: Reeded Front Console Cabinet
description: A long, low, rectangular storage cabinet with a dark top and base, featuring light gray reeded or fluted textured front panels. A vertical wooden accent divides the two main compartments, and the cabinet is supported by two pairs of short, dark, cylindrical legs.

name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Armchair
description: A Mid-Century Modern style armchair featuring a wooden frame and gray fabric upholstery. The chair has four tapered wooden legs. The curved backrest is upholstered and seamlessly connects to the open, flat wooden armrests. The seat is also upholstered in a matching gray textured fabric.

name: Contemporary Side Table with Integrated LED Lighting
description: A contemporary accent table featuring a circular black glass top supported by a minimalist dark-finished metal frame. The frame extends downwards to secure a cylindrical base made of a frosted, translucent material, which illuminates from within, suggesting integrated LED lighting. The overall aesthetic is modern and sleek, combining a functional surface with an ambient light source.

name: Two-Drawer Nightstand with Lower Shelf
description: A contemporary nightstand featuring two storage drawers and an open lower shelf, all finished in a muted olive green color. It stands on four tapered legs and is equipped with simple silver-finished knob pulls.

name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a solid wooden frame and soft bouclé upholstery. The chair has a rounded backrest, a padded seat, and slender, tapered wooden legs. Small integrated wooden armrests extend from the backrest. The overall aesthetic is minimalist with a nod to mid-century modern design.

name: Contemporary Walnut Sideboard Cabinet
description: A long, low wooden cabinet, likely a sideboard or credenza, made from walnut wood. It features a minimalist design with four cabinet doors and distinct rounded edges on its top and side profiles, giving it a seamless, fluid appearance. The base is integrated into the side panels, creating a clean, plinth-like support.

name: Contemporary Molded Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary, armless lounge chair constructed from a single piece of molded terracotta-colored plastic. It features a monolithic, sculptural form with smooth, rounded edges and an integrated base, creating a seamless and inviting ergonomic seat.

name: Traditional Leather Club Chair
description: A dark brown leather upholstered armchair, viewed from the rear. It features a tall, rounded backrest, suggesting a comfortable and classic design. The sides show a glimpse of the rounded armrests, and the chair is supported by small, square block feet.

name: Modern Bentwood and Fabric Counter Stool
description: An armless modern counter stool featuring a light-toned bentwood frame with a curved, sculptural design and upholstered seat and backrest in a neutral fabric. It includes an integrated dark footrest bar.

name: Modern Gray Fabric Modular Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, consisting of a three-seater section and an integrated chaise lounge or large ottoman. It features clean lines, broad track arms, and separate seat and back cushions.

name: Velvet Table Lamp
description: A contemporary table lamp featuring a broad, conical lampshade and a slender, tapered conical base, both upholstered in a deep red velvet fabric. The lamp is accented with polished brass elements at the foot of the base and connecting the shade to the base. A matching red fabric-covered power cord extends from the base, completing the cohesive design.

name: Cylindrical Channel-Tufted Ottoman with Brass Base
description: A contemporary cylindrical ottoman featuring plush channel-tufted upholstery in a neutral cream color, supported by a sleek metallic plinth base.

name: Two-Tone Nightstand with Drawer and Cabinet
description: A compact, two-tone storage unit featuring a top drawer and a lower double-door cabinet, accented with black bar handles. The top surface has a light wood finish, while the body is off-white with vertical panel detailing on the cabinet doors. It rests on small, black block feet.

name: Upholstered Wood Frame Bench
description: A long, rectangular bench featuring a deeply channel-tufted upholstered seat set upon a minimalist wooden frame with tapered legs. The upholstery is a rich green velvet-like fabric adorned with a light-colored chevron pattern.

name: Stacked Modular Storage Cabinet
description: Two distinct, trapezoidal storage units are stacked vertically. Each unit features an angled, off-white front panel with a cluster of three small, dark spherical knobs. The main body of each unit is a warm, matte orange/rust color with smoothly rounded edges. The top unit is slightly offset or rotated relative to the bottom one, creating a dynamic, sculptural form.

name: Transitional Skirted Upholstered Armchair
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a high, subtly curved backrest, rolled armrests, and a skirted base. The chair is covered in a light beige fabric with a woven geometric diamond pattern. The skirt of the base is gathered with pleats.

name: Contemporary Green Upholstered Swivel Armchair
description: A contemporary swivel chair featuring a circular upholstered seat and curved backrest in dark green, supported by a polished brass pedestal base.

name: Red Metal Stackable Stool with Perforated Seat
description: A bright red metal stool featuring a circular seat with a perforated pattern. The stool has four slender legs that splay slightly outwards, connected by a circular footrest ring. Black rubber caps are present on the feet.

name: Traditional Floral Upholstered Settee
description: A traditional style settee featuring a dark stained wooden frame with turned legs and spindle back/arm supports. The seat cushion is upholstered in a solid, light beige fabric with button tufting, while the low back and armrests are covered in a multi-colored floral pattern fabric, predominantly featuring red, green, and cream tones. Nailhead trim accents the bottom edge of the seat.

name: Contemporary Office Guest Chair
description: A contemporary office guest chair featuring brown upholstered seat and backrest, supported by a polished chrome or silver-finished metal frame. The backrest is horizontally ribbed, and the chair includes integrated armrests with padded tops. The legs are slender and straight, suggesting a fixed-base design.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered chair featuring a curved, enveloping backrest and integrated armrests. The chair is covered in a warm, reddish-brown fabric, possibly velvet or a similar plush material, which shows some gathered detailing on the inner backrest. It rests on four slender, angled, dark-colored metal legs. The design emphasizes comfort and a modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Dark Wood and Tan Leather Dining Chair
description: A modern dining chair featuring a robust dark-stained wooden frame with integrated minimalist armrests and upholstered seat and back in a warm tan leather. The design is characterized by its clean, geometric lines and substantial construction.

name: Contemporary Square Coffee Table with Brass Trim
description: A low-profile, square coffee table featuring a dark, possibly glass or stone, top surface. The top is framed by a brass-toned metal border that forms the side panels of the table. It rests on a slightly recessed, dark plinth base, giving it a minimalist and modern appearance.

name: Woven Seagrass Floor Lounge Chair
description: A low-profile lounge chair constructed entirely from natural woven fibers, likely seagrass or jute. It features a seat and an integrated backrest, both covered in a dense, chunky weave, with the seating surface incorporating a finer, more intricate woven pattern. The chair is designed for floor-level lounging and has a warm, natural aesthetic.

name: Marble Three-Legged Side Table
description: A small, round side table constructed entirely from variegated green and brown marble. It features a circular tabletop supported by three thick, cylindrical legs, showcasing natural veining and color variations.

name: Scandinavian Light Wood Frame Three-Seater Sofa
description: A minimalist three-seater sofa featuring an exposed light-toned wooden frame and plush white cushions. The design incorporates clean lines and a contemporary aesthetic, characteristic of Scandinavian modern furniture. The back cushions are lightly tufted with a single button, and the armrests are integrated into the continuous wooden frame, which extends down to form tapered, rounded legs.

name: Marble Pedestal Stool
description: A monolithic pedestal stool or side table crafted from veined marble. The cylindrical form features a flat top surface and a base with three or four arched cut-outs that create a sculptural, leg-like appearance. The marble displays natural variations in color, including shades of green, grey, white, and reddish-brown, with prominent swirling patterns.

name: Rectangular Extendable Wooden Dining Table with Rounded Corners
description: A rectangular dining table crafted from wood, featuring a medium brown finish with visible grain. The tabletop has subtly rounded corners and a distinct double-edged profile. Visible seams indicate an integrated extension mechanism, suggesting it can accommodate one or more leaves. The table is supported by four tapered, round legs.

name: Contemporary Wood and Rope Dining Chair
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a dark wood frame with gracefully curved armrests that seamlessly integrate into the backrest. The backrest is composed of vertical, tightly-strung natural-toned rope weaving, offering a visually light and breathable element. The seat is upholstered in a rich, distressed brown leather cushion, providing a comfortable and contrasting texture. The chair is supported by four sturdy, tapered wooden legs.

name: Upholstered Vanity Accent Chair with Toile Pattern
description: An upholstered accent chair featuring a round seat and a low, curved backrest, both covered in a detailed blue and white toile de Jouy fabric. The chair is supported by four straight, cylindrical black legs.

name: Art Nouveau Style Decorative Ottoman
description: A cuboid piece of furniture with rounded edges, featuring an elaborate, multi-colored abstract design. The design includes wave-like patterns at the base in shades of purple and gold, with organic shapes and geometric elements in greens, blues, and gold leaf on the upper surfaces. The overall aesthetic is artistic and decorative.

name: Contemporary Pleated Fabric Accent Chair
description: An armless contemporary accent chair featuring a cylindrical base with vertical pleated fabric upholstery. It has a circular, cushioned seat and a low, T-shaped backrest, all upholstered in a light, neutral-colored woven fabric.

name: Purple Tufted Upholstered Square Ottoman with Splayed Wooden Legs
description: A square, upholstered ottoman featuring a vibrant purple textured fabric with a deep button-tufted top. It stands on four splayed, light-toned wooden legs, giving it a modern and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Minimalist Tapered Concrete Display Pedestal
description: A tall, tapered rectangular pedestal made of light grey concrete, featuring a central rectangular cut-out that runs through its height, creating an open, architectural form. The surface has a raw, matte concrete finish.

name: Modern Grey Upholstered Three-Seater Sofa with Adjustable Headrests
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in a light grey fabric, featuring plush, segmented cushions and distinctive adjustable headrests. The design includes gently rolled armrests and two matching throw pillows, with a grey patterned throw blanket draped over one arm. The sofa rests on subtle wooden leg accents visible at the ends.

name: Modern Walnut Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A modern dining chair constructed from dark-stained walnut wood, featuring a gently curved solid wood backrest and four tapered legs. The seat is upholstered in a light-colored fabric with an abstract, organic pattern.

name: Upholstered Tubular Metal Stool with Animal Print
description: A small, square upholstered stool or ottoman featuring a black tubular metal frame with distinctive curved legs and support, topped with a cushion upholstered in a beige fabric with a black animal print pattern.

name: Ornate Carved Hardwood Elephant Pedestal
description: A highly ornate, richly carved wooden pedestal or column, featuring intricate decorative elements throughout its structure. The base is adorned with multiple elephant heads, while the central shaft showcases delicate floral patterns, lotus motifs, and a carved bell. The capital and plinth are multi-layered with deep relief carvings, presenting a traditional and elaborate aesthetic in a medium brown wood tone.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Sofa
description: A contemporary sofa featuring distinct channel-tufted or ribbed upholstery in a light grey textured fabric. The sofa has a streamlined, armless design with a low profile, offering a modern aesthetic. It includes two matching throw pillows.

name: Light Wood Multi-Storage Cabinet with Shelves and Drawer
description: A tall, rectangular storage unit constructed from light-toned wood laminate, featuring a combination of open shelving, double-door cabinets, and a single drawer. The unit has a minimalist design with simple brushed metal pull handles.

name: Modern Upholstered Bucket Accent Chair
description: A modern upholstered accent chair featuring a sculpted bucket seat and integrated armrests, supported by four slender, tapered legs. The chair is finished in a deep blue fabric upholstery, offering a sleek and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Curved Headboard and Sculpted Wood Legs
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a high, rounded headboard and a fabric-covered frame. The bed is supported by distinctive sculpted wooden feet. It is presented with white bedding and two sets of throw pillows.

name: Faux Bamboo Wooden Side Chair Frame
description: A light brown wooden chair frame, featuring an ornate design that mimics bamboo stalks. The backrest is composed of vertical faux bamboo spindles between horizontal ones, leading down to a rectangular seat frame. The legs and stretchers also display the characteristic segmented nodes of bamboo. The seat area is currently empty, indicating it is either a frame intended for a separate cushion or seat pad, or it is an incomplete chair. The finish is a glossy, natural wood tone.

name: Ornate Carved Stone Garden Bench
description: An ornate, light-colored carved stone bench designed for outdoor use. It features an intricately carved backrest with floral and scroll motifs, flanked by decorative openwork armrests. The seat is solid, and the bench is supported by two substantial pedestal-style legs with curved, scrolled bases.

name: Contemporary Checkerboard Upholstered Accent Chair
description: A contemporary armless accent chair featuring a distinctive checkerboard pattern upholstery in brown and beige tones. It has a round, cushioned seat and a uniquely curved, kidney-shaped backrest. The chair is supported by four slender, tapered legs made of dark-stained wood, giving it a playful yet stylish aesthetic suitable for various modern interiors.

name: Oak Platform Bed with Cane Headboard and Tapered Legs
description: A modern platform bed frame crafted from light-toned wood, featuring a distinctive rounded headboard with natural cane (rattan) webbing and elegantly tapered legs. The frame includes integrated wooden slats for mattress support.

name: Modern Black Spindle-Back Windsor Dining Chair
description: A modern take on a classic Windsor-style dining chair, rendered entirely in black. It features a high spindle back with a gently curved crest rail, a solid, slightly contoured seat, and four splayed legs reinforced with H-stretchers. The monochromatic finish provides a contemporary aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Fabric Track Arm Sofa
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. It features clean lines, track arms, and two large seat cushions. The backrest is composed of two loose cushions, complemented by three decorative throw pillows—two in olive green and one in a light tan hue. The sofa rests on small, recessed wooden block feet.

name: Fully Upholstered Armless Slipper Chair
description: A fully upholstered single seating unit, resembling a slipper chair or compact bench. It features a low, gently curved backrest that seamlessly transitions into the seat. The entire piece is covered in a light beige or natural-toned textured fabric, accented with crisp white piping along the seams of the seat and back. The base is also fully upholstered and extends to the floor, presenting a solid, skirted silhouette with a subtle concave curve at the bottom.

name: Modern Asymmetrical Upholstered Daybed
description: A modern, asymmetrical daybed featuring a curvilinear form factor, upholstered in a light beige fabric. It has integrated low-profile backrests that follow its organic shape, and is accessorized with several decorative throw pillows in varying patterns and solid colors.

name: Modern Oriental Daybed with Integrated Table
description: A long, low-profile daybed with a dark wooden frame, featuring two upholstered sections with cream-colored cushions and bolster pillows, separated by a central black integrated table. The backrest has a decorative spindled design.

name: Ornate Wrought Iron Vanity Stool
description: An ornate wrought iron vanity stool featuring a round upholstered seat and an intricately scrolled frame that forms both the backrest and the legs. The metal frame is dark, likely black, complementing the light beige seat cushion.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Pedestal Side Table
description: A contemporary small round table featuring a dark wood finish. The tabletop is perfectly circular, resting on a distinct pedestal base. The base consists of a central cylindrical column that subtly transitions into a bulbous, turned element, supported by a flat, circular foot that mirrors the shape of the tabletop. The design is minimalist and modern, emphasizing clean lines and the natural grain of the wood.

name: Multi-tiered Wooden Floral Display Stand
description: A multi-tiered display stand crafted from light-toned wood, featuring four distinct platforms, each shaped like a blooming flower with overlapping petals. The platforms are supported by slender, rounded wooden stems of varying heights, one of which has an organic curve near its base. The design emphasizes natural wood aesthetics and a sculptural, botanical form.

name: Modern Two-Seater Sofa with Integrated Cushions
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring light blue textile upholstery, integrated seat and back cushions, and rounded armrests. The sofa sits on a dark, minimalist base frame, suggesting a contemporary or minimalist aesthetic.

name: Traditional Mahogany Pedestal Accent Table with Drawer
description: A dark brown wooden pedestal accent table, featuring a square top with a small drawer, a turned central column, and three curved cabriole legs. A dark, distressed ceramic vase containing bare branches rests on top of the table.

name: Modern Upholstered Swivel Desk Chair with Rolled Backrest
description: A contemporary swivel desk chair featuring a distinctive backrest composed of two stacked, horizontally upholstered tubular elements in a vibrant orange fabric. The circular seat is upholstered in a contrasting dark blue fabric. The chair is supported by a light-colored, possibly wooden or painted metal, curved frame that connects the seat and backrest. It sits on a chrome-plated gas lift cylinder attached to a five-star base with casters, allowing for mobility and height adjustment. The base itself appears to be a light beige or off-white metal.

name: Modern White Textured Bean Bag Chair with Green Accent Cushion
description: A large, round, off-white bean bag chair with a textured fabric finish, featuring a small, square sage green accent cushion placed in its center.

name: Woven Rope and Wood Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a bucket-style seat and backrest meticulously hand-woven from natural beige rope with striking black accent stripes. The supportive frame consists of four slightly splayed, light-toned wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Velvet Single-Arm Accent Chair
description: An upholstered accent chair featuring a single integrated armrest and a deep, plush seat. The design is contemporary with soft, rounded edges throughout, covered in a camel-colored velvet-like fabric. The chair has a substantial, block-like base, contributing to its modern and inviting aesthetic.

name: Modern Curved Blue Velvet Armless Chair
description: A modern, low-profile accent chair featuring a distinctive curved silhouette, fully upholstered in a rich blue velvet fabric. The chair's backrest seamlessly flows into integrated armrests, creating a continuous, sculptural form that rests close to the ground. The design is contemporary and sleek, with no visible legs from most angles, providing a clean and substantial appearance.

name: Contemporary Two-Seater Sofa with Sculpted Wood Arms
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a rounded, plump silhouette upholstered in a textured sage green bouclé fabric. The sofa includes distinctive dark, sculpted wooden panels on the exterior of its arms, which extend downwards to form part of the base.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Bench with Sculpted Rolled Ends
description: A minimalist dark brown wood bench featuring a long, rectangular seat with distinctively sculpted, upward-curving rolled ends. The seat is supported by two thick, cylindrical or half-cylindrical legs, providing a sturdy and clean aesthetic. The wood displays a prominent grain pattern and a smooth, polished finish.

name: Natural Pine Single Drop-Down Door Nightstand
description: A compact, natural pine nightstand or small cabinet featuring a single storage compartment accessed via a front panel with a circular cutout acting as a handle. Its construction consists of thick, light-colored wooden planks with visible grain, forming a rectangular top, solid side panels that also serve as legs, and a recessed base.

name: Modernist Tubular Metal Frame Two-Seater Sofa with Corduroy Upholstery
description: A two-seater sofa featuring a minimalist tubular metal frame, supporting thick, comfortable cushions upholstered in brown corduroy fabric. The design is clean and contemporary, with the frame forming the arms and backrest.

name: Modern Double Sink Wood Bathroom Vanity with Open Shelf
description: A modern double-sink bathroom vanity featuring a rich brown wooden cabinet base, topped with a light-colored stone composite countertop and integrated white sinks. The base includes two cabinet doors on either side, two central drawers, and a full-width open shelf along the bottom, all supported by four sturdy wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Navy Blue Wingback Armchair with Nailhead Trim
description: A contemporary wingback armchair featuring deep navy blue textured fabric upholstery. The chair has a dramatically tall backrest with pronounced, elegantly curved wings and track arms, all accentuated by a continuous line of polished metal nailhead trim.

name: Pink Velvet Scalloped Swivel Accent Chair
description: A stylish accent chair featuring a barrel-shaped design with a distinctive scalloped backrest and armrests, upholstered in a soft pink velvet fabric. The chair sits on a round, polished brass swivel base, offering both functionality and a touch of glamour.

name: Contemporary Barrel Accent Chair with Two-Tone Upholstery
description: A contemporary barrel-shaped accent chair featuring a sophisticated two-tone upholstery. The inner seating area and back are covered in a smooth, light cream or off-white fabric, providing a sleek appearance. The outer shell, including the integrated arms and base, is upholstered in a contrasting textured fabric, likely a linen or bouclé blend, in a light beige or natural tone. The chair has a low profile with no visible legs, contributing to its modern and sculptural aesthetic. Its rounded form offers a comfortable, embracing feel.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Modular Armless Chair
description: A contemporary modular armless chair, upholstered in a textured, plush fabric of a warm, earthy camel-brown color. The unit features a low-profile design with a solid base and a separate, soft seat cushion. The backrest is gently curved and incorporates horizontal channel tufting, providing both aesthetic detail and ergonomic support. Its armless construction allows for versatile placement, either as a standalone accent piece or as part of a larger modular seating arrangement.

name: Contemporary Deep Green Two-Seater Sofa with Rounded Arms
description: A two-seater sofa upholstered in a deep green textured fabric. It features a soft, rounded silhouette with integrated, plump armrests that gently curve inwards. The seat base is distinguished by a subtle buttonless tufting pattern, creating a grid-like visual texture. Two large, loose rectangular back cushions are placed against the backrest. The sofa is supported by short, dark, cylindrical feet, giving it a low-profile stance.

name: Contemporary Ribbed Upholstery Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a low, rounded backrest that seamlessly transitions into integrated armrests. The chair has a circular seat cushion, and both the backrest/armrests and seat are upholstered in a textured, ribbed fabric in a burnt orange or terracotta hue. It is supported by four slender, cylindrical metal legs with a polished chrome or silver finish.

name: Dark Wood Modern Stepped Bookshelf and Magazine Rack
description: A modern, dark-stained wood shelving unit featuring a distinctive stepped and cantilevered design. It comprises three flat shelves for stacked items and an upper backrest-like element that forms an angled slot, ideal for displaying magazines or larger books. The unit is supported by integrated L-shaped legs, presenting a minimalist aesthetic.

name: Mid-Century Modern Wood Frame Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary or mid-century modern style lounge chair featuring a prominent exposed dark wood frame and upholstered cushions in a light gray fabric. The chair has a low profile with an angled backrest and splayed legs, offering a comfortable and stylish seating option.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed with Organic Headboard and Matching Tufted Bench
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a distinctive organic-shaped headboard, paired with a matching tufted bench. Both pieces are covered in a textured, light beige fabric, likely a boucle or similar weave, providing a soft and inviting aesthetic. The bed frame is fully upholstered, creating a cohesive and plush appearance.

name: Round Dining Table with Sculptural Wood Base
description: A contemporary round dining table featuring a dark, sleek tabletop and a sculptural pedestal base made of dark stained wood. The base consists of multiple curved panels that converge at the center, creating a visually striking and stable support structure. The visible wood grain on the base adds texture, contrasting with the smooth surface of the top. The overall aesthetic is modern and elegant.

name: French Provincial Upholstered Bench
description: A French Provincial style upholstered bench featuring a rectangular padded seat covered in a patterned fabric, supported by a wooden frame with elegant cabriole legs.

name: Rattan Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary swivel armchair featuring a curved dark brown frame, likely rattan or bentwood, and plush cream-colored upholstered cushions. The chair has a circular base enabling 360-degree rotation.

name: Rounded Corduroy Accent Chair
description: A single-seater upholstered accent chair featuring a distinctive rounded and cohesive silhouette. The chair is entirely covered in a ribbed, corduroy-like fabric in a rich burnt orange color, giving it a soft texture. It has integrated, gently curving armrests and backrest that form a continuous profile. The base is low and minimally exposed, contributing to its compact and modern aesthetic.

name: French Provincial Upholstered Armchair
description: An elegant French Provincial style armchair featuring a visible, ornate carved wooden frame and light-colored fabric upholstery. The chair has a curved backrest, open arms with scrolled details, and cabriole legs, indicative of its classic design. It includes a loose seat cushion and a loose back cushion, both upholstered in a neutral linen-like fabric.

name: Modern Wood Conference Table
description: A rectangular conference table crafted from wood or wood-look material, featuring a light to medium brown finish with a visible grain pattern. The tabletop is thick with gently rounded corners. It is supported by two solid, rectangular panel legs connected by a central modesty panel or support beam, creating a sturdy and minimalist design.

name: Contemporary Rectangular Panel-Leg Table
description: A contemporary rectangular table featuring a light wood grain finish. The tabletop has subtly rounded corners, giving it a soft, modern aesthetic. It is supported by two solid, thick panel legs, which are connected by a recessed modesty panel that runs almost the full length of the table, creating a robust and unified base structure. The overall design is minimalist and functional.

name: Ornate Carved Wooden Decorative Pedestal
description: An ornate carved wooden pedestal featuring intricate botanical motifs. The pedestal has a hexagonal base from which a central structure rises, flanked by three radiating, multi-tiered elements. Each of these elements is extensively carved with leaf and floral patterns, culminating in a turned finial at the top. The overall design suggests a traditional or exotic aesthetic, with a dark, rich wood finish accentuating the detailed craftsmanship.

name: Upholstered Dark Wood Bar Stool with Bolster Back
description: A contemporary bar stool featuring a sturdy dark wood frame, an amply padded upholstered seat cushion, and a distinctive cylindrical bolster backrest. The seat is covered in a plush, light brown/tan fabric, while the backrest is upholstered in a contrasting fabric with a geometric or abstract pattern in darker tones. The four legs are straight with subtle tapering towards the bottom, connected by cross stretchers for stability. The overall design combines functional height with sophisticated aesthetics.

name: Modern Curved Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair distinguished by its deep, organically curved seat and a low, supportive backrest, both generously upholstered in a rich, dark olive green plush fabric. The chair's fluid lines suggest comfort and a relaxed posture. It is supported by a sturdy, dark-stained wooden base featuring four subtly tapered legs, which complement the chair's sophisticated aesthetic. The design emphasizes soft forms and tactile comfort, making it an inviting piece of modern furniture.

name: Modern Sculptural Walnut Accent Table
description: A small, dark brown, wooden table with a rectangular top and a sculptural base. The base consists of three rounded, curved legs that merge at the center and support the tabletop. A small, conical, tapered element protrudes upwards from the center of the tabletop. The entire piece appears to be made of solid wood, likely walnut, with a smooth, matte finish. Its design is very modern and organic.

name: Modern Walnut and Leather Bar Stool
description: A modern bar stool featuring a dark walnut wood frame, a padded medium-brown leather seat, and a minimalist backrest. The design incorporates a copper-finished footrest and copper caps on the front legs, suggesting contemporary elegance.

name: L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A large, L-shaped sectional sofa featuring a right-hand facing chaise lounge. It is upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric and includes several loose back cushions. Multiple throw pillows in shades of green and a decorative pattern provide accent. The sofa is designed with clean lines, square track arms, and is supported by short, tapered wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Channel Tufted Velvet Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a dark olive green velvet fabric, vertical channel tufting on the exterior backrest, and slender black metal legs with brass-finished tips. The chair has a curved, enveloping back and armrest design.

name: Contemporary Tubular Back Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a distinctive tubular, curved backrest and a circular padded seat, all upholstered in a textured terracotta-colored fabric. The chair is supported by four slender black metal legs.

name: Dark Green Leatherette Armless Club Chair
description: A contemporary armless club chair upholstered in a dark green leatherette material. The chair features a compact, integrated design with a tall, gently curved backrest and a square seat, both fully upholstered. The base is a solid, rectangular block, creating a seamless and sturdy appearance. The overall aesthetic is minimalist with a touch of retro charm, characterized by its rounded edges and cohesive form.

name: Organic Modern Upholstered Dining Chair
description: An organic modern dining chair featuring a fully upholstered, organically shaped seat and back in a light, neutral fabric, supported by four tapered dark wood legs. The chair has a sleek, minimalist profile with no visible arms.

name: Wooden Upholstered Dining Chair
description: A classic wooden dining chair featuring an upholstered seat and backrest. The frame is constructed from a light-to-medium brown wood, likely oak, with a smooth finish. The backrest has a gently arched top rail, flanking two vertical wood slats and an upholstered central panel. The seat cushion is upholstered in a textured grey fabric, matching the back panel. The legs are straight and sturdy, with horizontal stretchers connecting them for added stability.

name: Contemporary Ribbed Upholstery Lounge Sofa
description: A contemporary low-profile lounge sofa featuring a distinct ribbed upholstery in an earthy brown hue. The sofa has a segmented backrest and seat cushions, with a particularly elongated, armless section on the right side designed for lounging. It rests on a sculptural, flared wooden base that provides a sturdy yet elegant foundation, lifting the body of the sofa off the floor. The overall aesthetic is minimalist, organic, and comfortable, suitable for modern living spaces.

name: Contemporary Walnut Media Console with Curved Edges
description: A contemporary media console or TV stand crafted from dark-toned wood, featuring a long, low profile with distinctive rounded edges on the top and sides. The front comprises four cabinet doors, each with a subtle vertical plank or slatted texture. The console is supported by an integrated, continuous frame that forms short, bent-wood style legs, giving it a light, floating appearance. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and modern, emphasizing natural wood grain.

name: Woven Rattan and Chrome Frame Lounge Chair
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a chrome-plated tubular steel frame and a woven rattan or synthetic wicker seat and back. The design incorporates a sled-style base for stability and integrated armrests with woven details, offering a sleek, relaxed aesthetic.

name: Neoclassical Empire Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant chaise lounge featuring a distinct Neoclassical Empire style. It is upholstered in white fabric, contrasting with a black-painted wooden frame adorned with intricate gold gilt accents, including a prominent Greek key fretwork pattern along the base. The piece has a single, gracefully scrolled armrest on one end, supported by an equally elaborate black and gold frame. It rests on short, gently curved saber legs, showcasing a blend of classical influences and refined craftsmanship.

name: Distressed Whitewashed Wood Coffee Table with Turned Legs
description: An elongated coffee table featuring a distinctive scalloped tabletop made from distressed, whitewashed wood. It is supported by four turned legs connected by a central stretcher, all finished to match the tabletop in a light, aged appearance.

name: Contemporary Carved Wood and Marble Nightstand
description: A square, pedestal-shaped nightstand or side table featuring a dark wood body with a distinctive wavy, carved texture on all visible sides. It is topped with a square slab of variegated green marble. Horizontal lines on the facade suggest integrated storage, likely drawers.

name: Solid Wood Console Table with Pedestal Base
description: A contemporary console table crafted from solid, light-toned wood, featuring a rectangular top and a single, sculptural pedestal base with an undulating texture.

name: Organic Modern Boucle Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a sculpted, dark wood frame and plush, cream-colored boucle upholstery. The frame exhibits smooth, organic curves, with integrated armrests that flow into the back support. The rounded seat and back cushions provide a soft, inviting contrast to the solid wooden structure.

name: Minimalist Wooden Daybed with Upholstered Bolsters
description: A minimalist daybed featuring a light-toned wooden frame and two-tone fabric upholstery. It has a long, rectangular main cushion in a light brown hue, complemented by two integrated bolster cushions at either end in a lighter beige fabric. The frame has rounded edges and extends into four sturdy legs.

name: Modern Upholstered Two-Seater Sofa with Track Arms and Bolster Pillows
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a clean-lined design with track arms and upholstered in a light beige fabric. It includes loose seat cushions, large back cushions, two square throw pillows, and two cylindrical bolster pillows. The sofa is supported by slender, dark metal legs.

name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Armchair
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a dark wood frame with a distinctive mid-century modern aesthetic. The chair has a curved, organic wooden structure that forms the legs, armrests, and back support. The seat and backrest are padded and upholstered in a light, textured fabric, likely off-white or cream. The armrests are integrated into the frame, providing support for the upholstered arm pads. The legs are tapered, contributing to the elegant profile.

name: Traditional Turned-Wood Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A classic-style dining chair crafted from dark brown wood, featuring turned elements on the legs and back supports, and a comfortably upholstered circular seat in a light beige fabric.

name: Sculptural Dark Wood Side Chair
description: An elegant, modern side chair crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring a sculpted, ergonomic design. The chair has an armless profile with a gently curved backrest and a contoured seat. Its four tapered legs splay slightly outwards, contributing to its organic and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Minimalist Interlocking Wood Lounge Chair
description: A minimalist wooden chair, constructed from interlocking flat panels. The chair features a sloped backrest and a flat seat, both appearing to be crafted from a light-toned hardwood with a visible grain. The design emphasizes clean lines and simple geometry, with no visible fasteners. A rectangular cutout is present on the upper part of the backrest. The chair stands on a broad, stable base formed by the extensions of the main panels.

name: Modern Round Slatted Coffee Table
description: A low-profile, modern round coffee table featuring a dark gray slatted top and three robust, angled block legs. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a light gray upholstered seat and a curved backrest with integrated armrests. The frame and legs are constructed from natural-toned wood, with the arms partially exposed to showcase the wood grain. The design is modern and minimalist, suitable for various interior settings.

name: Organic Modern Curved Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A large, light gray curved sectional sofa with a rounded chaise end, featuring soft, organic lines and plush back cushions, accented with furry decorative pillows.

name: Round Green Geometric Upholstered Ottoman
description: A round upholstered ottoman featuring a deep green fabric with a prominent geometric chevron pattern in a lighter contrasting tone, supported by four tapered wooden legs.

name: Natural Stone Bench
description: A low-profile bench crafted entirely from variegated green and white natural stone, featuring a thick, rectangular top surface supported by two robust, organically shaped pillar legs.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Fabric Loveseat
description: A contemporary loveseat featuring a beige fabric upholstery with distinctive channel and square tufting. The design is blocky and minimalist, with integrated wide, square armrests.

name: Solid Wood Pedestal Side Tables Set
description: A set of two solid wood tables, each featuring a round tabletop and a conical pedestal base. One table is taller and has a smaller diameter top, while the other is shorter with a larger diameter top. Both exhibit a rich, reddish-brown wood grain.

name: Mid-Century Style Upholstered Armchair with Houndstooth Pattern
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a distinctive houndstooth pattern in shades of maroon and light brown, supported by four tapered wooden legs. The armchair has a rounded back and arms, with a loose back cushion, also upholstered in the same pattern. Its design suggests a mid-century modern aesthetic.

name: Solid Wood Trestle Dining Bench
description: A long, rectangular solid wood bench featuring a thick, smooth top and two robust slab-style legs. The legs are connected by a substantial horizontal stretcher bar, forming a trestle base. The wood exhibits a pronounced grain pattern and a dark, warm brown finish.

name: Modern Platform Bed with Upholstered Headboard and Matching Foot Bench
description: A modern platform bed with a split upholstered headboard in white, a sleek gloss black frame, and a matching upholstered foot bench with geometric black legs. The bed is dressed with white bedding.

name: Contemporary Plush Two-Seater Sofa
description: A front view of a rust-colored upholstered two-seater loveseat with a plush, modern design. It features soft, rounded armrests and backrests, with subtle button tufting on the back cushions and a textured fabric finish.

name: Upholstered High-Back Armchair with Nailhead Trim
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a tall, straight back and gently curved arms. The chair is covered in a white fabric with a repeating beige geometric diamond pattern.
