It is accented with individual brass nailhead trim along the edges of the seat and the backrest. The frame includes dark brown wooden legs; the front legs are turned and tapered, while the back legs are saber-shaped. The armrests are also crafted from dark brown wood, with a smooth, curved design.

name: Contemporary L-Shaped Rolled Arm Sectional Sofa
description: An L-shaped sectional sofa with a light cream or off-white fabric upholstery. It features rolled arms, multiple loose seat cushions, and loose back cushions, along with several accent pillows. The sofa rests on short, dark, tapered block feet.

name: Modern Minimalist Chair
description: A modern minimalist chair featuring a circular seat, four stout cylindrical legs, and a distinctive U-shaped backrest, all finished in a uniform dark blue color.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a solid wood frame and tapered legs. The seat and backrest are fully upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric with dark flecks. The chair's design includes integrated armrests that curve elegantly into the backrest, outlined with a contrasting dark brown piping detail. The overall aesthetic is clean and modern.

name: Ornate Wooden Display Pedestal
description: A tall, traditional wooden pedestal featuring a dark brown finish. It has a square top surface, a rounded, turned capital below the top, a smooth cylindrical shaft, and a square, heavily carved base. The base includes recessed panels adorned with concentric rosette carvings, flanked by small pilasters or columns.

name: Modern Bentwood and Upholstered Dining Chair
description: A modern dining chair featuring a curved bentwood backrest with a central horizontal cutout functioning as a handle. The seat is upholstered in a dark brown material, likely faux leather or fabric, offering a comfortable pad. The chair is supported by four slim, tapered metal legs in a dark finish, splaying slightly for stability. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Velvet Sofa with Wavy Back
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in dark blue velvet, featuring a distinctive wavy backrest and integrated, curvaceous armrests. The upholstery appears plush and slightly draped, contributing to a relaxed yet elegant aesthetic. The sofa sits low, presenting a substantial and inviting form.

name: Sculptural Brass Lounge Chair
description: A highly sculptural lounge chair featuring a continuous, organic form. The exterior shell is a brushed bronze or brass-toned metallic finish, while the interior seating area is upholstered in a dark brown, possibly velvet or leather-like, material. The chair's design is fluid and abstract, resembling a modern art piece more than a conventional chair.

name: Modern Collaborative Office Table with Integrated Power Modules
description: A long, modern conference table with a light-toned wood tabletop and robust, angular dark metal bases. The tabletop features two integrated black power/data modules, indicating its suitability for collaborative work environments.

name: Modern Oak and Acrylic Console Table
description: A modern console table featuring a thick, rectangular solid oak wood top with visible grain, supported by two clear acrylic panel legs. The wooden top is affixed to the acrylic legs using polished metal brackets, creating a minimalist and floating appearance. The table is long and narrow, designed to be placed against a wall.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair
description: A modern armchair characterized by its sculptural, monolithic design and soft, rounded forms. The chair is fully upholstered in a light sage green material, likely leather or high-quality faux leather, giving it a smooth and seamless appearance. Its backrest and integrated armrests form a continuous, gentle curve, flowing down into four thick, cylindrical legs. Visible stitching defines the edges and contours, adding a subtle detail to its otherwise sleek silhouette. The design is contemporary, emphasizing comfort and minimalist aesthetics.

name: Transitional Wood Dining Chair with Ribbed Upholstery and Nailhead Trim
description: An armless dining chair featuring a solid wood frame in a dark brown finish. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a ribbed, possibly corduroy-like, fabric in a terracotta or reddish-brown hue. The backrest is adorned with decorative nailhead trim along its edges, adding a touch of traditional detail. The chair has a sturdy construction with a slightly splayed leg design, characteristic of transitional furniture styles.

name: Three-seater gray fabric sofa with tufted back cushions
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in light gray fabric, featuring grid-tufted back cushions, plain seat cushions, straight arms, and subtle tapered wooden legs.

name: Modern Scalloped Oak Two-Drawer Desk
description: A contemporary desk crafted from light oak wood, featuring a rectangular top, two integrated drawers with a distinctive scalloped edge along the bottom, and panel legs with a connecting stretcher bar.

name: Distressed Leather Barrel Accent Chair
description: A compact, round accent chair upholstered in distressed dark brown leather, featuring a cylindrical base and a curved backrest that seamlessly integrates with short armrests.

name: Contemporary Cognac Leather Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring cognac-colored leather upholstery, a plush seat cushion, and dark, tapered legs. The design incorporates gently curved armrests that flow into the backrest, offering a sleek and inviting profile.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Wood Legs
description: A long, modern, upholstered sofa in a light cream or off-white fabric, featuring deep seats, plump back cushions, and wide, gently sloping armrests. It is supported by visible, curved wooden legs. Two decorative throw pillows, one brown and one black-and-white patterned, are also present.

name: Contemporary Curved Boucle Sofa
description: A contemporary curved sofa upholstered in a creamy white boucle fabric, featuring a low-profile design and soft, organic lines. The sofa appears to be composed of two distinct segments, suggesting a modular construction that forms a gentle curve. It lacks visible legs, giving it a floor-level or very low-set appearance, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Oval Marble Top Walnut Console Table
description: A contemporary console table featuring a long, oval-shaped top made of brown veined marble, resting on a solid dark walnut wood base. The base consists of two thick, rectangular slab legs connected by a horizontal stretcher that integrates a single, shallow drawer.

name: Modern Upholstered Panel Bed
description: A modern bed featuring a dark brown wood frame with light beige upholstered panels on both the headboard and a low-profile footboard. The design is minimalist with clean lines, presenting a contemporary aesthetic suitable for various bedroom interiors. A white mattress and pillow are present, indicating a complete bed setup.

name: Sculptural Wooden Dining Armchair with Cowhide Upholstery
description: A dark brown wooden chair with a distinctive sculptural backrest and tapered legs, featuring a seat and partial backrest upholstered in a cowhide-patterned material.

name: Organic Shaped Brutalist Textured Brass Coffee Table
description: A striking coffee table featuring an organically shaped, thick brass tabletop with a deeply textured surface resembling concentric tree rings or water ripples. The heavy brass top rests on four short, recessed, rectangular block legs, likely made of dark-finished metal or wood, providing a low-profile and stable base. The table's design exudes a Brutalist aesthetic combined with natural, organic forms.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A modern upholstered lounge chair featuring a distinctive curved, organic form, finished in a speckled grey fabric and mounted on a dark, circular swivel base. It includes a matching lumbar cushion.

name: Terracotta Upholstered Convertible Floor Sofa Bed
description: A terracotta-colored upholstered convertible floor sofa bed. It features a low-profile design with multiple layers of plush cushions, suggesting it can transform from a sofa into a flat sleeping surface. The fabric has a textured, soft appearance.

name: Mid-Century Modern Light Wood TV Stand with Sliding Doors
description: A light wood, mid-century modern style TV stand featuring a long, low profile, tapered legs, a central open shelf, and two sliding cabinet doors with integrated pulls.

name: Contemporary Terracotta Velvet Barrel Accent Chair
description: A contemporary barrel-shaped accent chair, fully upholstered in a rich terracotta-colored velvet or plush fabric. The chair features a distinctive curved backrest that seamlessly transitions into integrated armrests, creating a cohesive, sculptural silhouette. The seat is a fixed cushion, and the entire piece rests on a solid, block-like base formed by the continuous upholstery, giving it a sturdy and grounded appearance.

name: Solid Wood Dining Chair with Dished Seat
description: A single solid wood chair, likely made of oak or a similar hardwood, featuring a minimalist design. The chair has a distinctive round, dished seat for ergonomic comfort. Its backrest is a simple, rectangular slab of wood with a slight curve, supported by two vertical stiles that extend from the rear legs. The four legs are thick and straight, providing a sturdy base. The wood has a warm, medium-brown finish.

name: Modern Natural Wood Two-Drawer Nightstand with Wavy Fronts and Spherical Feet
description: A modern nightstand crafted from natural light-toned wood, featuring a rectangular body with two stacked drawers. The drawer fronts are distinguished by a playful, wave-like or scalloped cut-out along their bottom edge, acting as integrated pulls. The entire unit rests on four prominent spherical wooden feet, which add a whimsical and sturdy base.

name: Modern Asymmetrical Executive Desk
description: A modern executive desk featuring a rectangular top crafted from medium-toned wood, appearing to float above its base. The base is asymmetrical, composed of a dark brown, solid-sided storage unit on the left and a distinctive angled panel leg on the right. An integrated modesty panel or structural beam in a matching medium wood tone connects the two support elements beneath the tabletop, adding visual interest and stability. The design emphasizes clean lines and contrasting wood finishes.

name: Contemporary Two-Seater Leather Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa, or loveseat, upholstered in smooth, light taupe-colored leather. It features clean lines, square track arms, two plush back cushions, and two deep seat cushions, all accented with subtle piping. The sofa is elevated on slender, angled legs with a polished brass finish, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Two-Tone Wood Bouclé Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a distinctive two-tone wooden frame and bouclé upholstery. The chair has a light-colored wooden structure that forms the legs and parts of the frame, complemented by a darker, curved wooden band that cradles the seat and connects to the backrest. The seat and the gently curved backrest are generously padded and upholstered in a textured, light beige bouclé fabric. The legs are tapered, and the overall design emphasizes smooth lines and a sophisticated aesthetic suitable for modern interiors.

name: Square Wooden Coffee Table with Integrated Drawers
description: A square, low-profile coffee table made of dark brown wood, featuring two integrated drawers and a minimalist, sturdy design. The top surface is flat, showing natural wood grain.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair with Wood and Brass Legs
description: This image displays a modern upholstered armchair featuring a low-profile design with a gently curved backrest and integrated armrests. The chair is covered in a textured gray fabric and rests on a distinctive base combining dark walnut-finished wood with four slender, tapered legs capped with polished brass.

name: Modern Chrome Cantilever Armless Chair with Zebra Print Upholstery
description: An armless cantilever chair featuring a polished chrome tubular steel frame that forms a continuous loop, supporting both the seat and backrest. The seat and back are upholstered in a plush, textured fabric adorned with a distinctive beige and brown zebra-like animal print.

name: Two-Tier Metal Wire Storage Shelving Unit
description: A two-tier, rectangular storage unit constructed entirely from silver-colored metal wire. The unit features an open grid design, forming both the shelves and the side panels, and rests on a minimalist U-shaped base. Its aesthetic is modern and industrial.

name: Three-Seater Track Arm Sofa
description: A modern three-seater sofa featuring a clean, minimalist design. It has straight track arms, three loose seat cushions, and three loose back cushions. The sofa is upholstered in a light beige textured fabric and supported by short, tapered dark wood legs.

name: Olive Green Recamier Chaise Lounge
description: A classic recamier chaise lounge featuring rolled arms at both ends, upholstered in a muted olive green velvet-like fabric. It stands on turned dark wooden legs and includes a matching bolster pillow positioned at one end.

name: Modern Bouclé Accent Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame
description: A modern accent armchair featuring a rounded, continuous backrest and armrests upholstered in off-white bouclé fabric, supported by a visible, rectangular wooden frame and legs.

name: Sculptural Bouclé Lounge Chair
description: A white, sculptural lounge chair upholstered in a textured bouclé fabric, featuring a distinctive organic, armless form with a low seat and an integrated, curved backrest that flows into a headrest-like elevation, all presented against a clean white background.

name: Contemporary Folded Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair with a unique folded, continuous form, upholstered in a light olive-green textured material, likely leatherette. The chair features integrated armrests and a low-slung profile, creating a minimalist yet sculptural aesthetic. It rests directly on its wide base without traditional legs.

name: Modern Walnut Upholstered Bench
description: A modern upholstered bench featuring a rectangular cream fabric cushion atop a solid warm-toned wooden frame with distinctive curved, arch-like legs and sculpted bases.

name: Mid-Century Modern Bentwood Lounge Chair
description: A Mid-Century Modern style lounge chair featuring a gracefully curved dark bentwood frame and plush upholstered cushions in a light grey, textured fabric. The frame forms integrated open armrests and a sled-style base.

name: Modern Console Table with Colorful Rope Base
description: A modern console table featuring a live-edge style wooden top and a base made from numerous colorful, intertwined rope-like elements. These elements create an hourglass-like silhouette, connecting the top to a rectangular wooden plinth at the bottom. The ropes are vibrant in colors like red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, providing a striking contrast to the natural wood grain.

name: Plum Lacquer Coffee Table with Integrated Marble Top and Sculptural Pedestal Bases
description: A contemporary coffee table featuring a rectangular top with rounded corners, finished in a high-gloss plum lacquer. The tabletop includes an integrated, recessed rectangular panel of white marble with reddish-brown veining. The table is supported by two large, sculptural, bulbous pedestal bases, also finished in the matching plum lacquer, giving it a distinctive and bold aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Grey Fabric Two-Seater Sofa with Rolled Arms and Turned Wood Bun Feet
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in a light grey woven fabric. The sofa features plush, removable seat and back cushions, gently rolled armrests, and rests on four visible turned wooden bun feet. The overall design is clean and inviting, with visible stitching detail on the cushions.

name: Neoclassical Marble Pedestal Accent Table
description: A refined round pedestal table featuring a polished marble top, an ornate bronze or brass frieze around the apron, and an elegant off-white fluted columnar base resting on a tiered octagonal plinth.

name: Modern White Pedestal Side Table
description: A minimalist white round side table featuring a thick, smooth tabletop supported by a distinctive pedestal base composed of four inward-sloping panels.

name: Modern Bentwood Bar Stool with Molded Seat
description: A modern bar stool featuring a sculpted black seat atop a frame of light-toned bentwood legs, reinforced with a black metal footrest. The design is contemporary and minimalist.

name: Modern Rectangular Solid Oak Dining Table with Spider Base
description: A modern rectangular dining table featuring a solid oak wood top with natural grain patterns and a distinct black powder-coated metal spider-leg base. The design is contemporary, emphasizing both natural materials and geometric structure.

name: Modern Chrome and Glass Serving Cart
description: A sleek, two-tiered serving cart featuring a polished chrome tubular frame and glass shelves. The top shelf is a smoked or tinted glass, while the bottom shelf is clear glass with a chrome wire rack on one side. The cart is equipped with four swivel caster wheels for easy mobility.

name: Contemporary Organic Terracotta Cord Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a distinctive sculptural form crafted from tightly woven terracotta-colored synthetic cord. The chair exhibits a continuous, fluid line that shapes the backrest, integrated armrests, and a curvilinear base, creating an open-weave aesthetic. It is equipped with a light grey seat cushion for comfort and rests on discreet, low-profile feet.

name: Minimalist Oak Upholstered Armchair
description: A minimalist armchair featuring a light oak wood frame and light grey/beige textured fabric upholstery. The chair has a distinctive curved backrest that integrates seamlessly into the armrests, and an upholstered seat pad. The design emphasizes clean lines and natural materials, suitable for contemporary interiors.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a unique sculptural metal frame with integrated armrests and contrasting upholstery. The chair's backrest is upholstered in a white, brown, and gray patterned fabric with a scenic or toile-like design, while the seat cushion is covered in a lighter, solid gray or off-white fabric. The frame, which appears to be dark bronze or antiqued brass, forms elegant, curvilinear back legs that merge into the armrests and support the backrest, with straighter, tapered front legs. The design combines artistic form with functional seating, suitable for upscale interior settings.

name: Modern Sculptural Glass Coffee Table
description: A modern coffee table featuring a clear, circular glass top supported by a unique, sculptural white base. The base consists of flowing, curvilinear forms that interlock and rise to meet the glass, creating an artistic and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Black Leather Channeled Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a continuous tubular chrome-plated steel frame that forms the arms, legs, and sled base. The seat and back cushions are upholstered in black leather with distinctive horizontal channeling, giving them a padded, slightly wrinkled appearance. The design is sleek and minimalist.

name: Contemporary Pink Fabric Accent Armchair
description: A modern upholstered accent armchair featuring a curved back and integrated arms, a separate seat cushion, and four slender, tapered black metal legs, all in a uniform pink fabric.

name: Traditional Tufted Leather Executive Swivel Office Chair
description: A luxurious traditional executive office chair featuring a high back, deep diamond tufting, and nailhead trim on rich brown leather upholstery. It has carved wooden accents on the armrests and is supported by a five-star wooden base with casters and a swivel mechanism.

name: Modern Two-Seater Cognac Leather Sofa
description: A two-seater sofa with a modern design, upholstered in a rich cognac brown leather. It features clean lines, squared armrests, and two distinct seat cushions alongside two matching back cushions. The sofa is supported by slender, tapered black metal legs, giving it a minimalist and elevated appearance. A light-colored throw blanket is draped over one armrest.

name: Modern Glass Top Coffee Table with Cylindrical Legs
description: A modern rectangular coffee table featuring a clear glass top with softly rounded corners. The base is made of a dark burgundy-colored material, likely wood, and consists of four substantial cylindrical legs connected by a central horizontal stretcher.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Curved Arms and Metal Accents
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa characterized by its low-profile design and elegant curved arms. The sofa is upholstered in a light beige or greige fabric, providing a neutral and sophisticated aesthetic. It features a dark, recessed base, possibly made of wood, accented with polished gold or brass elements at the front corners, which subtly elevate the piece. The backrest is adorned with five throw pillows, alternating in shades of light and dark brown, adding texture and comfort. The overall design emphasizes modern luxury with its clean lines and soft, inviting curves.

name: Round Fluted Wood Side Table
description: A round side table featuring a dark brown wood finish. It has a circular tabletop with a subtle raised edge and a cylindrical pedestal base with vertical fluting, providing a textured appearance.

name: Sculptural Copper Art Chair
description: A small, sculptural chair crafted from a metallic material, resembling copper or bronze, with a distinctive heavily textured surface. The chair features irregular, circular perforations on both its seat and backrest, contributing to its unique aesthetic. The legs are robust, cylindrical, and seamlessly integrated into the chair's overall form, maintaining the same textured finish as the rest of the piece. Its design suggests it is as much a work of art as it is a functional seating object.

name: Industrial Style Hall Tree with Bench and Coat Hooks
description: An industrial-style hall tree featuring a light wood-toned bench, a matching top shelf, and a series of five black metal coat hooks, all integrated into a sturdy black metal frame. The design is minimalist and functional, intended for an entryway or mudroom.

name: Tropical Style Exposed Wood Frame Armchair
description: A sophisticated armchair featuring an exposed dark wood frame with elegant curved lines and an upholstered seat and back. The inner back is channel-tufted in a light cream fabric, while the outer back and sides are adorned with a patterned textile featuring a tropical leaf motif. The front legs are turned with spherical details, and the rear legs are tapered. A decorative throw pillow with a matching leaf pattern is placed on the seat.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Platform Bed with Layered Curved Headboard
description: A contemporary upholstered platform bed featuring a distinctive layered and curved headboard design. The entire frame and headboard are covered in a light beige fabric, presenting a soft and inviting aesthetic. The bed has a low-profile base, suggesting a platform construction where the mattress sits directly on the frame without requiring a box spring. It is dressed with light-colored bedding and complemented by an array of decorative pillows in varying shades of beige and brown, alongside a brown throw blanket draped across the foot of the bed.

name: Contemporary Channel-Tufted Boucle Sofa
description: A contemporary modular sofa featuring a soft, rounded silhouette upholstered in a textured off-white boucle fabric. The design incorporates channel tufting across the seat and back, creating distinct, plush sections. The sofa has a continuous, low-profile form, with subtle curved wooden accents integrated into the lower side panels.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame and Metal Accents
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a rounded backrest and seat, set within an exposed dark wooden frame. The chair has slender splayed wooden legs and subtle metallic details on the armrests, complementing its light beige upholstery.

name: Modern Rectangular Marble Dining Table
description: A modern rectangular dining table featuring a white marble top with prominent purplish-brown veining, supported by two solid, dark brown cylindrical wood bases. The table top has softly rounded corners, contributing to its sleek and contemporary aesthetic. The surface of the marble is highly polished, reflecting light, and the overall design is minimalist, emphasizing the natural beauty of the materials.

name: Art Deco Grey Velvet Loveseat with Burl Wood Arms
description: A two-seater loveseat featuring a distinctive Art Deco design. It has plush grey velvet upholstery for the seat and backrest, contrasted by large, curved, solid-looking burl wood armrests that seamlessly integrate with the plinth-style base. The wood exhibits a rich, dark brown color with prominent, intricate grain patterns. The overall form is elegant and substantial.

name: Rectangular Art Deco Inspired Lacquered Dining Table
description: A long, rectangular dining table featuring a dark, possibly navy blue or black, lacquered finish. The tabletop has a subtle beveled edge and is adorned with slim brass inlays running along its length and partially down the sides, intersecting the table's supports. It is supported by two substantial, tapered pedestal bases, also finished in the same dark lacquer, with vertical brass accents integrated into their design. The overall aesthetic is sleek, luxurious, and reminiscent of Art Deco design.

name: Modern Upholstered Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a plush, textured burnt orange upholstery and a sleek, rounded silhouette. The chair has integrated, broad arms and a low, curved backrest, suggesting a comfortable and enveloping seating experience. It appears to be supported by a discreet swivel base, allowing for easy rotation. The overall design emphasizes softness and fluid lines, consistent with modern and contemporary aesthetics.

name: Cream Contemporary Plastic Stool
description: A cream-colored, square-top stool featuring four thick, cylindrical legs with rounded edges. The design is modern and minimalist, presenting a cohesive, monolithic aesthetic.

name: Rounded Solid Wood Bookshelf with Slat Back
description: A freestanding bookshelf crafted from solid wood, featuring a distinctive rounded frame and five open shelves. The back panel incorporates vertical wood slats, and the piece stands on integrated U-shaped legs, creating a sleek and modern aesthetic. The wood has a rich, medium-to-dark brown tone with visible grain.

name: Modern Wood Chaise Lounge with Bolster Pillow
description: A modern chaise lounge featuring a dark-stained solid wood frame and a plush, textured light golden-beige velvet or chenille upholstered cushion. It includes a matching cylindrical bolster pillow. The design is low-profile and minimalist, with integrated block-style feet forming part of the sturdy wooden base.

name: Two-Tone Concrete-Effect Modular Home Office Unit with Integrated Desk
description: A comprehensive modular home office unit featuring a two-tone design with light and dark gray concrete-effect finishes. It includes wall-mounted upper cabinets, lower base units with drawers and doors, and integrated desk surfaces, all fitted with black bar pulls.

name: Modern Wooden Frame Upholstered Armchair
description: A modern armchair featuring a solid dark wood frame and upholstered seat and backrest. The frame consists of straight, cylindrical legs and integrated flat armrests, with the backrest having a distinctive curved top rail. The upholstery is a checkered fabric in varying shades of beige and light brown, creating a geometric pattern. The chair presents a clean, contemporary aesthetic, suitable for various interior settings.

name: Convertible Corduroy Futon Loveseat with Integrated Cup Holders
description: A compact, two-seater convertible futon sofa upholstered in a light beige ribbed corduroy fabric. The design features thick, stacked cushions that form the seat and back, suggesting a foldable or reclinable mechanism. Both armrests are wide and softly padded, each housing a recessed black plastic cup holder. A silver-toned metal support frame is visible on the right side, indicating the convertible nature of the piece. The overall aesthetic is casual and functional, ideal for smaller living spaces.

name: Upholstered Open-Back Dining Chair
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a unique open-back design, fully upholstered in a muted reddish-brown fabric, paired with dark, tapered wooden legs. The seat is round and generously padded, while the backrest forms an elegant, organic loop shape, providing both support and a distinctive aesthetic.

name: Artisan Pedestal Side Table with Perforated Top
description: A dark, round table with a perforated sunburst pattern on its surface, centered by a small, domed wooden element. It stands on a segmented, stacked wooden pedestal base in a rich brown hue, supported by a flat, dark circular foot.

name: Anglo-Indian Rattan and Turned Wood Adjustable Daybed
description: An antique Anglo-Indian daybed or chaise lounge crafted from dark-stained turned wood, featuring a natural fiber (likely rattan or woven cane) upholstered seat and an adjustable backrest. The frame exhibits distinctive spool-turned elements and finials, with the front legs fitted with small brass casters. The overall design suggests a colonial aesthetic, suitable for reclining and relaxation.

name: Contemporary Rope-Woven Armchair
description: A modern armchair featuring a solid wood frame, a rounded backrest, and intricately woven rope side panels and armrests. It includes a comfortable, upholstered seat cushion in a light, neutral fabric.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Cloud Armchair
description: A modern upholstered armchair featuring a distinctive cloud-like or scalloped silhouette. The chair is fully upholstered in a dark olive green or deep charcoal green fabric, providing a plush and inviting appearance. It has a low-profile, solid base that blends seamlessly with the body of the chair, contributing to its soft and organic aesthetic.

name: Traditional Outdoor Park Bench with Cast Iron Legs
description: A traditional outdoor bench featuring multiple light-toned wooden slats for the seat and backrest, supported by two intricately designed black cast iron frames on either end. The wood appears to have a natural finish, contrasted with the dark, decorative metalwork.

name: Modern Sculptural Boucle Lounge Chair
description: An upholstered lounge chair featuring a distinctive modern, sculptural design, covered entirely in a textured light neutral boucle fabric. The chair's form is curvilinear, with the backrest, seat, and base flowing seamlessly into one another, creating a plush and inviting appearance. Small, discreet glides are visible at the base.

name: Upholstered Winged Headboard Platform Bed with Mattress
description: A modern upholstered platform bed featuring a curved, winged headboard, presented with a mattress. The bed frame and headboard are entirely covered in a light beige or off-white textured fabric. The headboard exhibits two subtle vertical seams, suggesting a paneled design. The accompanying mattress is white with distinct black piping along its edges and displays a 'habitat' brand label.

name: Black Leatherette Dining Armchair with Curved Arms
description: A contemporary armchair upholstered in black leatherette, featuring a minimalist design with integrated, curved armrests that seamlessly flow into the backrest. The seat is cushioned, and the four sturdy legs are also covered in the same material.

name: Contemporary Woven Cane and Metal Bench
description: A contemporary bench featuring a rectangular form with a black tubular metal frame and an intricately woven natural fiber seat, likely cane or rattan, in a light beige color. The frame has clean lines and subtle rounded corners.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant, contemporary chaise lounge featuring an organic, curvilinear form upholstered in a dark brown fabric, resting on a circular natural wood plinth base. It has a distinct headrest section that curves upwards, providing support.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Cane Armchair
description: A traditional dark wood armchair featuring a cane woven backrest and seat. The chair has elegantly curved armrests and turned front legs, with saber-style back legs, indicative of a classic or colonial design.

name: Contemporary Scalloped Velvet Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a distinctive scalloped, shell-like backrest upholstered in deep blue velvet. The chair is supported by slender, tapered metal legs with a polished brass finish. The sides of the chair include panels adorned with a vibrant, multi-colored abstract or floral pattern, providing a visual contrast to the solid velvet.

name: Modern Low-Profile Fabric Loveseat
description: A modern, low-profile loveseat upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric. It features thick, square track arms, a deep seat cushion, and loose back cushions, along with two smaller accent pillows. The design is minimalist and contemporary, with no visible legs.

name: Modern Tapered Wood Base Table Lamp with Conical Shade
description: A modern table lamp featuring a solid wood base with a tapered, square pyramid-like shape, finished in a warm reddish-brown hue. It is topped with a wide, conical fabric lampshade in off-white, diffusing the light.

name: Wooden Storage Cabinet with Fluted Columns and Woven Panels
description: A compact wooden storage cabinet featuring a light to medium brown wood finish. The top surface has a slightly rounded edge. The cabinet's facade includes two smaller drawers at the top, two larger drawers below them, and two hinged doors at the bottom. The fronts of all drawers and doors are inset with a light-colored woven material, possibly rattan or cane. The cabinet is flanked by decorative fluted columns on the upper half, which transition into plain, slightly tapered legs. Each drawer and door is fitted with a small, dark-toned metal knob handle. The overall design suggests a traditional or transitional aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Rounded Asymmetrical Chaise Sofa
description: A modern, low-profile, asymmetrical sofa upholstered in a terracotta-colored fabric. It features softly rounded edges and an extended chaise-like section on the right, providing ample lounging space. Two spherical accent pillows in the same fabric are placed against the left armrest. The overall design is sleek and contemporary.

name: Live Edge Wood Coffee Table
description: A rectangular coffee table featuring a live-edge wood slab top, supported by two pairs of short, rectangular block legs. The wood exhibits a light to medium brown hue with natural, swirling grain patterns.

name: Channel-Tufted Barrel Accent Chair with Plinth Base
description: A contemporary barrel-shaped accent chair, fully upholstered in a textured beige fabric with distinct vertical channel tufting on the backrest and outer arms, supported by a low, dark wooden plinth base.

name: Modern Rounded Oak Coffee Table with Integrated Drawers
description: A modern, rectangular coffee table crafted from oak wood, featuring softly rounded edges and two integrated, flush-front drawers. The design incorporates a seamless waterfall effect where the side panels flow into the top surface.

name: Mid-Century Modern Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: An armless dining chair featuring a warm walnut-toned wooden frame and an upholstered seat with a green fabric adorned with a white abstract pattern. The chair exhibits clean lines, tapered legs, and a gently curved backrest with a distinctive cut-out detail.

name: Two-Tier Wrought Iron Console Table with Light Wood Shelves
description: A rectangular, two-tiered console table featuring a dark, possibly wrought iron frame with X-shaped side supports and horizontal crossbars. The two shelves are made of light-colored wood or laminate with a subtle grain pattern. A decorative, knob-like element adorns the central horizontal support between the X-shaped frames.

name: Minimalist Light Wood Round Stool
description: A light-toned, minimalist wooden stool featuring a round seat with a subtle handle cutout and four cylindrical legs. The legs are integrated directly into the underside of the seat, creating a clean and cohesive design. The wood grain is visible, indicating a natural finish.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining/Accent Chair
description: A contemporary upholstered chair featuring a curved, bucket-style seat and backrest, covered in a textured grey fabric. The chair is supported by four slender, black metal hairpin legs that splay outwards for stability. The design is sleek and minimalist, suitable for various modern interior settings.

name: Baroque Revival Carved Wood Wingback Armchair with Tartan Upholstery and Leather Accents
description: A highly decorative and traditional wingback armchair featuring an exposed carved wooden frame, tartan plaid fabric upholstery on the seat and back, and black leather accents on the outer back and armrests, all finished with brass nailhead trim. The chair has prominent cabriole legs and scrolled details indicative of Baroque or Rococo revival styles.

name: Cylindrical Panel-Faced Nightstand
description: A light-colored wooden nightstand with a distinctive cylindrical form factor. It features two storage drawers, each with a small brass knob pull. The body of the nightstand is visually textured with vertical wood paneling, segmented horizontally into three tiers. The circular top surface is flat, and the unit stands on a slightly recessed, solid circular plinth base, all crafted from wood with visible grain.

name: Modern Rounded Upholstered Accent Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a plush, rounded silhouette and thick cushioning, finished in a textured rust-red fabric. The chair has fully upholstered arms and back, with visible stitched seams that define its soft, inviting form. It rests on four short, cylindrical wooden feet, contributing to its low-profile and substantial appearance. The design emphasizes comfort and a soft, modern aesthetic.

name: Art Deco Inspired Curved Green Velvet Sofa
description: A large, elegant curved sofa upholstered in a rich, deep green velvet fabric. It features a distinctive segmented backrest with three separate cushions, each defined by contrasting white piping. This white piping also accents the gracefully curved arms and runs along the bottom edge of the seat cushion, adding a crisp, decorative detail. The sofa has a low-profile design and rests on a dark, recessed plinth base.

name: Organic Biomorphic Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring a distinctive organic, biomorphic form. It has a dark, possibly molded plastic or fiberglass base that forms a fluid, undulating perimeter, contrasting with soft, irregularly shaped, light-colored upholstered cushions. The design emphasizes natural, curvilinear lines and contrasting textures.

name: Modern Black Stained Wood Bench with Arched Supports
description: A minimalist, modern bench crafted from black stained wood, featuring a thick rectangular top supported by two robust, U-shaped arched legs. The wood exhibits a visible grain and textured finish, giving it a raw yet refined appearance. The design emphasizes sculptural form and substantial presence.

name: Transitional Cream Upholstered Armchair with Turned Wood Details and Botanical Patterned Back
description: A stylish armchair featuring an exposed dark wood frame, light cream upholstery, and a distinctive patterned outer backrest. The design combines classic turned wood elements with modern curves, creating a transitional aesthetic. A decorative throw pillow with a botanical leaf pattern is included.

name: Modern Extendable Dining Table with Faux Marble Top and Pedestal Base
description: A modern extendable dining table featuring a white faux marble top with a grey vein pattern, supported by a unique pedestal base composed of angled, light wood-look panels accented with black strips. The table's design suggests contemporary aesthetics and practical functionality.

name: Modernist Tubular Chrome and Leather Bench
description: A modernist bench featuring a polished tubular chrome frame and a thick, rectangular cushion upholstered in distressed brown leather. The minimalist design emphasizes clean lines and industrial materials, offering a sleek and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Solid Walnut Four-Drawer Chest of Drawers with Curved Fronts
description: A dark brown, four-drawer chest of drawers crafted from solid wood, likely walnut. It features distinctive convexly curved drawer fronts and matching integrated wooden knob pulls. name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary upholstered lounge chair featuring a distinctive sculptural form. The chair is fully covered in a light-colored, textured fabric, presenting a unified and organic silhouette. It comprises a rounded seat and back with integrated armrests, resting on a wide, tapered cylindrical base.

name: Faceted Brass Octagonal Coffee Table
description: An octagonal coffee table featuring a substantial, drum-shaped body constructed from multiple faceted brass panels. The top surface is flat and octagonal, mirroring the base's geometry. The brass has a warm, aged, or patinated finish, giving it a rich, golden-brown hue with subtle variations in tone. The overall design is sculptural and robust, characterized by clean lines and a low profile.

name: Art Deco Club Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame
description: An Art Deco inspired armchair featuring plush, terracotta brown velvet upholstery and a distinctive dark stained exposed wooden frame that forms the curved armrests and outlines the sides. It stands on four short, fluted bun feet.

name: Light Oak Armrest Bar Stool with Upholstered Seat
description: A modern armrest bar stool constructed from light-colored solid wood, featuring an integrated backrest and armrests. The seat is upholstered in a light beige or tan material, likely fabric or leatherette. The design is minimalist with clean lines, and the frame includes horizontal stretchers that serve as footrests. The wood grain is visible, indicating a natural finish.

name: Modern Wooden Nightstand with Integrated Lighting
description: A compact, square-shaped wooden nightstand with rounded corners and a minimalist design. It features two floating drawers with integrated LED lighting along the top edge, creating a warm glow. The lower section includes an open shelf, also illuminated from beneath, and appears to rest on a recessed base. The visible wood grain gives it a natural yet refined aesthetic.

name: Modular Corduroy Sectional Sofa
description: A contemporary modular seating unit, likely a sectional sofa, upholstered in a rich, ribbed corduroy fabric in a dark brown hue. It features three distinct cushioned segments for the seat and three corresponding backrest cushions, creating a low-profile, comfortable appearance. A brushed metal U-shaped support frame is visible on the right end, securing the cushions and providing a structural design element.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Accent Chair with Curved Backrest
description: A compact, contemporary accent chair featuring a circular upholstered seat and a continuous, curved upholstered backrest that doubles as partial arm support. The chair is supported by four slender, straight black metal legs. The upholstery is a light beige or cream-colored textured fabric, contributing to its minimalist and modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Plum Fabric Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in a rich plum-colored fabric, featuring a chaise extension on the left side. name: Contemporary Light Blue Boucle Chaise Lounge with Bolster Armrest
description: A contemporary chaise lounge upholstered in a light blue, textured boucle fabric.
