The chaise lounge rests on four short, cylindrical legs that are also fully upholstered in the matching fabric, creating a cohesive and minimalist design. Its overall aesthetic is soft and inviting, suitable for modern interiors.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Upholstered Dining Chair
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a fully upholstered, curved back and seat in a cream-colored bouclé fabric, supported by four splayed wooden legs with a natural light finish.

name: Modern Farmhouse Wood and Brass 8-Light Chandelier
description: A modern farmhouse style chandelier featuring a central turned light-toned wood body with eight curved antique brass arms. Each arm terminates in a candle-style bulb, resting on a small, round antique brass bobeche. The chandelier hangs from a matching antique brass chain and canopy.

name: Outdoor Two-Seater Sofa with Metal and Wood Frame
description: A modern outdoor two-seater sofa featuring a sturdy light-colored metal frame combined with slatted natural wood accents on the armrests and backrest side panels. The seating area includes thick, comfortable cushions upholstered in a light beige, weather-resistant fabric.

name: Distressed Leather Industrial Accent Chair
description: An accent chair featuring a dark gray distressed leather upholstery and an open, geometric metal frame with a bronze finish. The chair has a padded seat, backrest, and armrests with leather strapping details.

name: Rustic Solid Wood Trestle Dining Table
description: A long, rectangular dining table constructed from solid wood, featuring a rustic aesthetic. The tabletop is composed of multiple planks, showcasing natural wood grain and texture. It is supported by two sturdy trestle bases, each with a wide, footed base, connected by a prominent horizontal stretcher bar for stability. The overall design emphasizes a robust, natural, and timeless appeal.

name: Modern L-shaped Sectional Sofa with Wooden Base and Metal Legs
description: A modern L-shaped sectional sofa upholstered in light beige fabric, featuring an exposed wooden base trim and slender black metal legs. The sofa includes several decorative throw pillows in various patterns and a green knitted throw blanket draped over one arm.

name: Carved Wooden Wall Shelf
description: A dark brown carved wooden wall shelf, featuring intricate leaf and scroll motifs underneath the flat top surface. The shelf is designed to be mounted on a wall, providing a decorative and functional surface for display.

name: Carved Wooden Canopy Bed with Cane Headboard
description: A traditional wooden canopy bed featuring an intricately carved headboard with cane webbing, supported by four turned and fluted posts that extend upwards to form a canopy frame. The bed frame is constructed from a rich, dark brown wood, showcasing visible grain. The design incorporates both classic craftsmanship and natural textures, suitable for various bedroom aesthetics.

name: Contemporary Walnut-finish Media Console with Slatted Sliding Doors
description: A contemporary media console or TV stand constructed from wood with a warm, medium-brown, walnut-like finish. It features a long, rectangular top surface, an open central compartment, and two storage compartments on either side, each concealed by a vertically slatted sliding door. The doors have simple black pull handles. The unit rests on a recessed base supported by four short, solid block legs.

name: Modern Fabric Sectional Sofa with Chaise and Integrated Side Table
description: A modern sectional sofa featuring a modular design with a chaise lounge extension and an integrated side table at one end. It is upholstered in a light taupe or beige textured fabric, with loose back cushions that have button tufting and additional decorative throw pillows with patterned fabric. The sofa rests on a minimalist, slender metal frame that forms U-shaped legs, giving it a light, elevated appearance.

name: Modern Wood Frame Lounge Chair with Round Back Cushion
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a light natural wood frame, a rectangular seat cushion, and a distinctive circular back cushion, all upholstered in a cream-colored textured fabric. The wooden frame has gently curved armrests and an open slatted backrest.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair with Dark Wood Legs
description: A modern upholstered armchair featuring a subtly curved back and integrated armrests, set on elegantly splayed dark wood legs. The chair is covered in a light, textured fabric, giving it a contemporary and inviting appearance.

name: Drop-leaf Wooden Serving Cart with Glass Top
description: A traditional wooden serving cart featuring a drop-leaf top with a glass insert, supported by turned legs, and equipped with both large spoked wheels and small caster wheels for mobility. It includes a lower storage shelf.

name: Traditional Upholstered Wingback Armchair
description: A classic wingback armchair featuring light beige upholstered fabric, deep button tufting on the backrest, and antique brass nailhead trim along the armrests and base. The chair is supported by four dark, curved wooden legs.

name: Round Natural Wood Tray Coffee Table
description: A modern round coffee table crafted from light-toned natural wood, featuring a distinctive tray-style top with a raised rim. The top includes two subtle cut-outs on opposing sides, adding a design detail and potentially aiding in lifting or handling. The table stands on four straight, splayed wooden legs, contributing to its stable and contemporary Scandinavian aesthetic. The overall finish appears smooth and matte.

name: Modern Upholstered Channel-Tufted Platform Bed with Matching Bench
description: A modern upholstered platform bed featuring a tall, channel-tufted headboard and frame, accented with gold-finished metal trim, accompanied by a coordinating channel-tufted upholstered bench.

name: Traditional Carved Wooden Dining Chair with Floral Upholstery
description: A traditional wooden dining chair featuring a carved crest rail and decorative elements on the backrest. The seat and backrest panel are upholstered in a cream-colored fabric with an intricate floral and scroll pattern in muted tones of pink, green, and gold. The chair's frame is a warm brown wood, with elegantly curved cabriole front legs and straight square rear legs, connected by stretchers for stability. The overall design evokes a classic, ornate aesthetic suitable for formal dining settings.

name: Ornate Traditional Carved Wood Armchair with Damask Upholstery
description: An ornate traditional armchair featuring a medium-dark brown wooden frame with extensive carving. The chair has a tall back with a prominent carved crest rail and scrollwork. The arms are substantial, featuring a scrolled design at the front. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a light cream or beige fabric with a light gold damask pattern. The front legs are cabriole style with shell carving near the top, and the chair's overall aesthetic evokes classical or Rococo-inspired design.

name: Modern Organic Light Oak Coffee Table with Cylindrical Legs
description: A modern coffee table made from light-colored, natural oak wood, featuring a rectangular top with gracefully rounded edges and supported by four thick, cylindrical legs arranged in two distinct pairs.

name: Mixed-Material Sculptural Console Table
description: An exquisite sculptural console table featuring an assemblage of diverse high-quality materials including polished brass, translucent raw-cut quartz, white veined marble, and dark green variegated marble. The elongated rectangular top is segmented, with distinct sections of brass, quartz-like stone (where brass appears to fill natural fissures in a kintsugi-like manner), and white marble. The table is supported by an asymmetric, deconstructed base composed of a large, angular translucent stone block at one end and a sturdy column of dark green marble paired with a lighter beige marble block at the other. A slim, integrated brass shelf is positioned below the tabletop, connecting the disparate support elements and adding both visual interest and subtle utility.

name: Modern Solid Wood Bench with Contoured Seats
description: A long, low wooden bench featuring three distinct, subtly curved seating sections made from light-toned wood. The legs and support structure are also crafted from the same wood, forming a continuous, organic-shaped base, giving it a minimalist yet sculptural appearance.

name: Modern Upholstered Platform Bed with Integrated Nightstands
description: A modern upholstered bed featuring a distinctive, oversized headboard with a wide, curvilinear shape. The headboard is upholstered in a light grey textured fabric and curves around the sides, partially enclosing two integrated, round nightstands with dark wood veneer, each featuring two drawers. The bed frame itself is a low-profile platform design, also upholstered in the same light grey fabric, giving it a sleek and contemporary appearance. The bedding includes white sheets, pillows, and a brown throw.

name: Low-back Wooden Frame Leather Sling Accent Chair
description: A low-back accent chair featuring a light-toned wooden frame and brown leather sling seat and backrest. The leather elements are secured to the frame with visible dark metal fasteners, creating a sturdy, minimalist aesthetic. The chair has a simple, block-like wooden construction with straight legs and stretchers.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Swivel Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a dark, rounded frame with brass vertical spindle accents, light gray fabric cushions, and a fluted conical swivel base with a gold-toned trim.

name: Modern Wood-Framed Lounge Chair
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a dark-stained open wood frame and thick, light-colored upholstered cushions. The frame forms both the legs and armrests, creating a clean, architectural silhouette. The back cushion is separate from the seat cushion, and both are well-padded, suggesting comfort. The chair is photographed against a white background, highlighting its form and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Regency Style Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant Regency-style chaise lounge featuring a distinctive rolled backrest, a single armrest with baluster detailing, and classic striped fabric upholstery over an exposed wooden frame.

name: Contemporary Grey Fabric Tub Armchair
description: A contemporary grey fabric upholstered armchair with a rounded barrel-style back and integrated armrests, featuring a compact design and splayed black metal legs. The upholstery has a fine, textured weave.

name: Industrial Style Entryway Bench with Coat Rack
description: An industrial-style entryway hall tree featuring a light-toned wooden bench seat, a black metal frame, and an integrated coat rack with multiple hooks. The design is minimalist and functional.

name: Curved Modular Sectional Sofa
description: A deep maroon or burgundy modular sectional sofa featuring a distinctive curved, serpentine design. The sofa is composed of several upholstered sections that fit together to form a continuous, flowing seat. It has a low profile with integrated, gently rounded backrests and armrests, suggesting a contemporary and comfortable aesthetic. The fabric appears to be a textured, possibly bouclé or chenille material, providing a soft tactile quality. The item is presented against a plain white background, highlighting its form and color.

name: Rustic Reclaimed Wood Bench
description: A rustic, rectangular bench crafted from dark, distressed reclaimed wood. It features a thick, solid plank top supported by two sturdy A-frame leg structures, connected by a crossbar. The wood exhibits natural imperfections, grain variations, and visible signs of age, contributing to its rugged aesthetic. The construction appears robust with simple, exposed joinery.

name: White Oval Console Table with Drawer
description: A pristine white console table featuring an elongated oval tabletop. It is supported by four elegantly tapered legs, connected to the apron with a subtle scalloped detail. A single, central drawer with a brass-toned keyhole provides discreet storage. The entire piece is finished in a smooth, uniform white paint.

name: Modern Bentwood Swivel Bar Stool with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A modern bar stool featuring a light-toned bentwood frame, an upholstered seat and back, and a chrome footrest. The design is characterized by its curved forms and clean lines, with a swivel function.

name: Contemporary Organic Bouclé Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a distinctive, organic form, fully upholstered in a textured, light beige bouclé fabric. The chair's structure is composed of rounded, curvilinear shapes that form the base, seat, back, and integrated armrests, creating a cohesive and sculptural silhouette. Its low profile suggests a relaxed seating experience.

name: Contemporary Light Gray Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: A contemporary light gray sectional sofa featuring a right-facing chaise lounge, three back cushions, and block-style arms and feet. The upholstery appears to be a durable woven fabric.

name: Organic Modern Accent Table
description: A low-profile accent table featuring a distinctive organic, undulating tabletop with soft, rounded edges, supported by three thick, cylindrical legs. The entire piece is rendered in a monochromatic, matte greige finish, embodying a minimalist and sculptural aesthetic.

name: Upholstered Swivel Office Chair with Armrests
description: A contemporary swivel office chair featuring olive green textured fabric upholstery on both the seat and backrest. It has integrated loop-style armrests made of polished metal. The chair is supported by a five-star base with casters, also in polished metal, and includes a visible lever for height adjustment. The design emphasizes a functional yet stylish aesthetic suitable for modern workspaces.

name: Modern Three-Seater Upholstered Sofa
description: A modern three-seater sofa upholstered in a neutral beige or taupe fabric, featuring a clean, minimalist design. It has padded track arms, three distinct seat cushions, and three plush back cushions with subtle tufting. The sofa is supported by short, tapered wooden legs, adding a touch of Scandinavian or contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern Curved Walnut Nightstand with Drawer
description: A compact, modern nightstand or bedside table crafted from dark-toned wood, featuring smoothly rounded continuous edges, an integrated pull-out drawer, and an open lower storage compartment.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Dark Wood Upholstered Accent Chair
description: A contemporary, low-profile accent chair featuring a sculptural dark wood frame with a contrasting light upholstered seat. The chair's design is characterized by thick, curved wooden panels forming the seat, backrest, and base, with visible wood grain. The base consists of two substantial, angled supports with a central vertical cut-out, creating a distinctive and stable structure. The upholstered seat pad is light-colored, offering a visual contrast to the dark wood.

name: Modern Square Slatted Teak Outdoor Dining Table
description: A modern square dining table crafted from light-toned wood, likely teak, designed for outdoor use. It features a slatted tabletop with a defined border and a unique, open-work base composed of vertical and horizontal wooden slats forming a geometric cage-like structure. The table has a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern L-Shaped Sectional Sofa with Integrated Wood Side Tables
description: A sophisticated L-shaped sectional sofa featuring a low-profile design, upholstered in a light grey fabric, and accented with dark wood integrated side tables. It includes multiple back cushions for comfort.

name: Mid-Century Modern Emerald Velvet Three-Seater Sofa with Walnut Frame
description: A stylish three-seater sofa featuring a distinctive mid-century modern design. The sofa is upholstered in a rich emerald green velvet fabric, with square tufting on the back cushions. The frame is constructed from dark walnut wood, forming gracefully curved open armrests and a base that supports individual seat cushions. The sofa stands on slender, tapered wooden legs, complementing its minimalist yet elegant aesthetic.

name: Dark Stained Wood Bar Stool with Carved Backrest
description: A sturdy, dark stained wood bar stool featuring a distinctive backrest with a scalloped top edge and three circular cutouts. The stool has a square, flat seat and four robust, round legs connected by integrated footrests for stability. Its construction suggests solid wood craftsmanship.

name: Modern Organic Console Table
description: A modern console table with a distinctive organic-shaped tabletop, supported by two robust, sculptural leg bases. The entire piece is finished in a uniform matte black, revealing subtle wood grain texture.

name: Vintage Chrome Cantilever Lounge Chair with Tufted Brown Velvet Cushions
description: A low-slung lounge chair featuring a polished chrome tubular cantilever frame, supporting thick, plush brown velvet cushions. The seat and back cushions are generously padded and tufted, providing a comfortable and relaxed seating experience. The design suggests a vintage aesthetic, likely from the 1970s or 1980s.

name: Modern Upholstered Side Chair with Metal Legs
description: An armless side chair featuring a blue upholstered seat and backrest, supported by slender blue tubular metal legs. The chair has a modern and minimalist design with gently curved contours.

name: Two-Piece Modular Chaise Sofa
description: A two-piece modular chaise sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. Each module features a deep, low-profile seat with a small, rectangular backrest cushion, and an additional smaller rectangular throw pillow. The design emphasizes comfort and versatility, allowing for various configurations. The sofa sits low to the ground on small, discreet black feet. The upholstery appears uniform across all surfaces, creating a cohesive and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Plaid Upholstered Swivel Armchair with Plinth Base
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a contemporary design with a classic plaid pattern. The chair has a boxy, fully upholstered frame with wide, slightly flared block arms and a straight back. It includes a loose seat cushion and a loose back cushion, both upholstered in the same plaid fabric. The chair rests on a visible wooden plinth base, which likely incorporates a swivel mechanism for rotational movement.

name: Two-Tone Contemporary Chaise Lounge
description: A contemporary chaise lounge featuring a two-tone upholstery design. The extended seat and single curved backrest are upholstered in a light gray textured fabric, while the base and exterior of the backrest are covered in a contrasting brown material, possibly faux leather or suede. It includes two toss pillows, one of which has a decorative brown strap accent. The lounge rests on four tapered, dark-stained wooden legs, giving it a sleek and modern appearance.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Sofa with Exposed Wood Frame
description: A modern upholstered sofa featuring a light-colored, textured fabric and an exposed natural wood frame and legs. It has two broad seat cushions, two large back cushions, and two additional smaller throw pillows, creating a plush and inviting seating arrangement.

name: Modern Upholstered Chaise Lounge with Wood Base
description: A modern chaise lounge featuring dark fabric upholstery, a curved headrest, and a unique cylindrical armrest secured with leather straps and brass hardware, all supported by a dark, possibly ribbed, wood base.

name: Contemporary Three-Seater Sofa with Exposed Walnut Base
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa featuring a clean-lined design, upholstered in a muted taupe fabric. It has an exposed dark walnut wood base with matching tapered legs. The sofa includes three separate seat cushions and three loose back cushions, along with four accent pillows in varying shades of grey and taupe.

name: Black Textured Spherical Base Floor Lamp with Ruffled Textile Shade
description: A striking black floor lamp featuring a sculptural base composed of stacked spherical elements of varying sizes and textures, culminating in a tiered, ruffled textile lampshade. The base consists of smooth matte black spheres interspersed with highly textured, porous-looking spheres, creating visual interest. The conical shade is made from a woven or crocheted material, forming multiple horizontal ruffles that add depth and a unique tactile quality to the light fixture. The overall design is monochromatic and presents a bold, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern Extendable Dining Table with Starburst Pedestal Base
description: A modern extendable dining table featuring a light-colored, rectangular tabletop with softly rounded edges, supported by a distinctive starburst-style pedestal base composed of multiple intersecting rectangular beams. The table incorporates a hidden extension mechanism, allowing for increased seating capacity. Its neutral color palette and clean lines are characteristic of contemporary design.

name: Themed Decorative Side Chair
description: A brown, armless side chair with a slightly reclined backrest featuring golden decorative motifs and the text 'HES POLADE' on the top rail. The chair has a square seat with small golden corner details and four sturdy, tapered legs. The material appears to be molded plastic or a composite, simulating wood.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Barrel Back Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a solid dark wood frame and mixed upholstery. The backrest and integrated arms form a curved barrel shape, upholstered in a textured, light brown and off-white tweed-like fabric. The seat cushion is upholstered in a lighter, off-white fabric with subtle vertical stripes. The frame consists of four tapered legs and features distinctive turned wooden details at the top of the front leg supports, where they meet the armrests.

name: Modern Curved Upholstered Loveseat
description: An upholstered loveseat featuring a contemporary design with a curved back and integrated arms. The main body and plush seat cushion are upholstered in a light, textured beige fabric, while the lower base is covered in a contrasting dark brown fabric.

name: Modern Round Wood-Top Pedestal Bar Table
description: A modern bar table featuring a round, light wood-grain laminate tabletop supported by a single dark gray cylindrical metal pedestal base. The base is weighted and circular, providing stability. The design is minimalist and functional.

name: Contemporary Barrel Armchair with Houndstooth Upholstery
description: A modern armchair featuring a curved, solid-colored outer shell in a tan/orange hue, with the interior upholstered in a black and white houndstooth fabric. It stands on slender, gold-finished metal legs and has a matching gold-toned trim around its base.

name: Traditional Carved Teakwood Sofa with Linen Upholstery
description: A traditional-style three-seater sofa featuring a robust dark wood frame with intricate carved details. The sofa has a tall, slightly curved backrest frame and substantial armrests, both integrated into the wooden structure. The side panels of the armrests are adorned with elaborate, organic floral and vine carvings. The seating area consists of a base panel and a back panel, both upholstered in a plain, textured light brown fabric, likely linen or a similar blend, providing comfort against the solid wood frame. The lower front portion of the sofa features vertical wood paneling, giving it a sturdy and enclosed appearance.

name: Contemporary Powered Home Theater Recliner
description: A single-seat, contemporary powered recliner upholstered in beige leatherette, featuring integrated cup holders, illuminated control buttons on the armrest, and subtle ambient lighting along the base. The chair has a plush, segmented design with horizontal channel stitching on the seat and backrest, and includes a small black accent pillow.

name: Natural Wood Cross-Back Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A light-colored wooden chair featuring a distinctive cross-back design and an upholstered seat. The frame appears to be constructed from bentwood, providing a classic, slightly curved profile. The backrest consists of a curved top rail and two intersecting wooden slats forming an 'X' shape. The seat cushion is upholstered in a light, textured fabric, likely linen or a blend, in an off-white or light grey hue. The chair has four slender legs, with the rear legs extending upwards to form part of the back support. This design is commonly associated with bistro or farmhouse aesthetics.

name: Contemporary Fabric Two-Seater Modular Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater modular sofa with rectilinear block forms, upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. It features wide integrated armrests and distinct seat and back cushions with visible piping.

name: Kids Pink Velvet Bunny Bed
description: A pink velvet upholstered child's bed featuring a headboard shaped like bunny ears with a small bow detail. The bed frame has integrated low side rails on both sides of the mattress, providing security for a child. The mattress is visible and has a patterned white and gray cover. The overall design is whimsical and suitable for a child's bedroom.

name: Contemporary Modular L-Shaped Sectional Sofa with Chaise
description: An L-shaped modular sectional sofa featuring deep, plush seating and back cushions upholstered in a light-colored, textured fabric. The individual segments show visible stitching, creating a subtle channel-tufted or ribbed effect. The sofa includes an integrated chaise lounge on one end and comes with matching square and spherical throw pillows.

name: Wooden Frame Leather Upholstered Bar Stool with Armrests
description: A contemporary bar stool featuring a dark-stained solid wood frame and upholstered in rich cognac-colored leather. It has a square, architectural silhouette with integrated armrests and a gently curved backrest. The base includes horizontal stretchers that serve as footrests.

name: Modern Arc Floor Lamp with Wood and Frosted Glass Shade
description: A modern arc floor lamp featuring a dark-stained rectangular wooden column as its primary upright support. An arched metal arm, likely brushed nickel or brass, extends from the top of the wooden column, curving gracefully to suspend a horizontally oriented, elongated frosted glass shade. The base consists of a black-finished metal 'U' shaped support extending from the bottom of the wooden column, providing stability.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Dining Chair with Metal Legs
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring an off-white bouclé upholstered seat and backrest, supported by slender, splayed metal legs with a champagne finish. The backrest is gently curved and seamlessly integrates into short armrests.

name: Arts and Crafts Bentwood Side Chair with Studded Leather Seat
description: A dark brown wooden side chair featuring a tall, arching bentwood backrest with a central vertical support adorned with decorative ball finials. The seat is upholstered in dark brown leather, secured with visible metal studs. It stands on four cylindrical wooden legs, with spherical elements connecting the front legs to the seat frame.

name: Contemporary Cream Fabric Two-Seater Sofa with Wooden Platform Base
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa featuring cream-colored fabric upholstery and a distinctive dark wood platform base. The sofa has a low profile with two large seat cushions, two matching back cushions, and two loose, overstuffed armrest pillows. The solid wood base extends horizontally beyond the upholstered frame and is supported by recessed block legs, providing a floating appearance.

name: Modular Sectional Sofa
description: The image captures the rear and partial side view of a large, contemporary sectional sofa or modular sofa component. It is upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric, likely linen or a textured synthetic blend. The design features thick, rounded back cushions and armrests/side panels, giving it a soft, inviting aesthetic. The structure appears to be composed of distinct, possibly modular, upholstered blocks.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Chair with Splayed Metal Legs
description: A modern upholstered dining chair featuring a single, contoured shell seat and back, supported by a splayed, four-leg metallic base.

name: Upholstered Bed Frame with Curved Wood Headboard
description: A bed frame featuring a distinctive upholstered headboard and matching upholstered side rails and footboard. The headboard has an undulating top edge and is framed by a light-toned, possibly distressed, wooden border. The upholstered sections are covered in a textured reddish-brown fabric. A white mattress is visible within the frame.

name: Modular Sectional Sofa with Integrated Wood Platforms
description: A multi-piece modular sectional sofa upholstered in light beige fabric, featuring integrated dark wood side tables/armrests on several sections. The sofa has a low-profile design with subtly curved wooden block bases.

name: Stacking Metal Stool with Round White Seat
description: A modern, round stacking stool featuring a white plastic or laminate seat and four polished metal legs that curve inward, allowing for vertical stacking. Each leg is fitted with a black protective foot cap.

name: Contemporary Rounded Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric. It features softly rounded, continuous arms and a backrest that flow into a cohesive form. The sofa rests on a recessed, dark wood plinth base.

name: Sculptural Art Deco Revival Vanity Chair
description: A highly sculptural chair featuring a round, cushioned seat and a corresponding round, cushioned backrest, both upholstered in a light cream material. The chair's frame is constructed from richly polished dark wood, possibly a burl veneer, exhibiting a high-gloss finish. The base is notably asymmetrical, with one side supported by stacked polished wooden spheres and the other by a broad, curved, flat wooden panel that extends upwards to form part of the backrest support.

name: Modern Sculptural Walnut Coffee Table
description: A low, rectangular wooden coffee table crafted from dark walnut wood, featuring a tabletop with rounded edges supported by two thick, panel-style legs. Each leg incorporates three nested, semi-circular arched cutouts, giving it a distinctive sculptural and architectural appearance.

name: Contemporary Rounded Arm Fabric Sofa with Wood Accents
description: A contemporary three-seater sofa upholstered in a light beige textured fabric, featuring distinctive rounded arms and base accented with dark brown stained wood panels and a subtle metallic trim. The backrest exhibits channel tufting, and it comes with decorative throw pillows that include a brown strap detail.

name: Modern Metal and Stone Accent Table with Spherical Base
description: A modern accent table featuring a circular, dark-finished metal top with a textured surface, supported by a slender, dark metal stem. The stem is anchored by a large, spherical base made of light-colored stone, possibly marble or concrete. The design is minimalist and sculptural.

name: Modern Upholstered Wood Bar Stool
description: A modern bar stool featuring a circular upholstered seat and a low, curved backrest, set atop four dark brown, tapered wooden legs with a circular footrest ring. The upholstery is a light, cream-colored fabric with a subtle texture.

name: Mid-Century Solid Wood Bench with Raised Ends
description: A rectangular wooden bench featuring a minimalist design, splayed tapered legs, and subtle raised elements at each end, indicative of Mid-Century Modern aesthetics.

name: Modern Armless Side Chair with Tiger Print Upholstery
description: A modern armless side chair featuring a distinctive tiger print upholstered seat and back. The frame is constructed from bent metal tubing with a dark red finish, forming a continuous structure for the legs and support.

name: Modern Cane and Wood Accent Chair with Upholstered Cushions
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a natural light wood frame, cane webbing on the curved back and armrests, and plush upholstered cushions in an off-white fabric, accompanied by two decorative throw pillows.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Two-Seater Loveseat with Wooden Arm Accents
description: A contemporary two-seater loveseat upholstered in dark, textured fabric, featuring plush back and seat cushions. The design incorporates curved wooden accents on the outer portion of the armrests, complemented by small, round wooden feet. A single light-colored throw pillow with a wavy pattern rests on the seat.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair with Patterned Back
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a dark wood frame with a curved, barrel-style backrest upholstered in a rich, multi-colored patterned fabric. The seat cushion is a deep red velvet, providing a contrast to the back. The wooden legs are tapered and finished with elegant brass caps. The armrests are solid wood, smoothly integrated into the frame.

name: Modern Sculptural Dark Wood Console Bookshelf
description: A long, low, three-tiered shelving unit crafted from dark-stained wood. The design incorporates distinctive semi-circular or curved vertical dividers that create an undulating, sculptural pattern between the shelves. The shelves and base have rounded edges, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Sculptural Walnut and Marble Coffee Table
description: A contemporary coffee table featuring a rectangular white marble top with rounded corners, supported by a unique, sculptural dark walnut wood base. The base exhibits organic, flowing lines, creating a dynamic silhouette.

name: Modern Conical Table Lamp with Wood Base
description: A modern table lamp featuring a crisp white conical fabric shade, supported by a slender silver-toned metal stem. The stem emerges from a round, dark brown wooden base. A small, darker wooden detail and a flat metal disc are situated directly beneath the shade, adding subtle accents to the design.

name: Modern Terracotta Fabric Sofa with Adjustable Headrests
description: A contemporary sofa upholstered in a warm terracotta-colored textured fabric. It features a minimalist design with low, rounded arms that curve seamlessly, two wide seat cushions, and two cylindrical, adjustable headrests. The sofa is accessorized with several accent pillows displaying a light, abstract brushstroke pattern.

name: Blue-Grey Transitional Sideboard
description: A blue-grey painted wooden sideboard featuring three top drawers with dark cup pulls and three lower cabinet doors with round knobs. The cabinet doors are detailed with raised panels, and the entire unit rests on a plinth base, presenting a blend of classic and modern aesthetics.

name: Transitional Barrel Armchair with Wooden Trim
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a rounded barrel back, integrated arms with exposed dark wood trim, and turned wooden legs.

name: Modern Blue Upholstered Bar Stool with Backrest
description: A modern bar stool featuring a bright blue tubular metal frame and matching blue upholstered seat and backrest. The design is minimalist, with a padded square seat and a small rectangular backrest, both covered in a textured fabric. The frame includes a square-shaped footrest for comfort and stability, reflecting a monochromatic and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Integrated Headboard
description: A contemporary platform bed featuring a fully upholstered frame and an integrated, slightly padded headboard, all covered in a textured light beige fabric. The design is minimalist, offering a clean and streamlined look suitable for modern bedrooms. The bed includes a mattress support system, eliminating the need for a box spring. Two white pillows and a white fitted sheet are shown on the bed.

name: Modern Minimalist Arc Floor Lamp
description: A modern minimalist floor lamp featuring a black conical base, a slender, arcing stem, and a spherical, diffused light source. A small sphere acts as a counterweight on the opposing end of the stem, maintaining balance and adding a design accent.

name: Modern Dark Brown Leather Platform Bed with Integrated Side Tables
description: A modern dark brown leather platform bed featuring a wide, wrap-around headboard that seamlessly integrates two cylindrical side tables. The low-profile bed frame is also upholstered in dark brown leather. The bed is adorned with light grey bedding and two bolster pillows with a cowhide-like pattern.

name: Contemporary Plush Modular Two-Seater Sofa
description: A contemporary two-seater modular sofa featuring a plush, low-profile design with soft, rounded edges and upholstered in a light beige, textured fabric. It consists of two individual seat and backrest modules placed side-by-side, forming a cohesive lounging unit.

name: Contemporary L-Shaped Sectional Sofa with Modular Cushions
description: An L-shaped sectional sofa featuring a contemporary modular design. The sofa is upholstered in a light greige, textured bouclé-style fabric. It has a distinctive deep-tufted or channel-stitched base and individual, rounded back cushions that appear movable or interchangeable. Several small black throw pillows are placed along the backrest.

name: Modern Round Marble Top Pedestal Side Table
description: A modern round side table featuring a white marble top with subtle gray veining, supported by a sleek black pedestal base. The tabletop has a thin black rim, complementing the matte black finish of the cylindrical column and wide circular base, which provides stability. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Postmodern Sculptural Wave Lounge Chair
description: A striking purple lounge chair featuring a continuous, sculptural wave-like form. The chair is entirely upholstered in a textured fabric, presenting a seamless, legless design that serves as both seat and backrest, characteristic of avant-garde furniture.

name: Chinese Hardwood Daybed Sofa
description: A traditional Chinese-style daybed or sofa, featuring a robust dark wood frame with a slatted backrest and curved armrests. It is outfitted with thick, firm cream-colored upholstered cushions for both the seat and back, complemented by two cylindrical bolsters and a smaller square accent pillow. The design incorporates intricate joinery visible in the sturdy legs and base structure, suggesting a heritage aesthetic with contemporary comfort.

name: Mid-Century Modern Walnut Accent Side Table
description: A small, three-legged table featuring a rounded triangular top crafted from dark brown walnut wood with prominent grain. The top has a gently curved edge profile. Three slender, tapered, and slightly splayed legs support the top, connecting seamlessly to its underside. The overall design suggests a Mid-Century Modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Dining Chair with Cane Back and Upholstered Seat
description: A contemporary dark wood dining chair featuring a gracefully curved frame, a woven cane backrest, and a plush white upholstered seat. The chair's legs are tapered, and the backrest slightly extends forward to provide subtle arm support.

name: Contemporary Track Arm Sofa with Integrated Side Table
description: A long, contemporary sofa featuring light beige fabric upholstery, track arms, and a distinctive dark brown wooden base that extends to form an integrated side table on one end. The sofa includes multiple loose seat and back cushions, along with accent throw pillows in a darker brown shade, complementing the base. Its design emphasizes clean lines and a low profile.

name: Mid-Century Modern Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A classic Mid-Century Modern lounge chair featuring a distinctive bent plywood shell, rich tan leather upholstery, and a polished metal swivel base. The chair has three distinct upholstered sections: a padded headrest, a backrest, and a seat cushion, all button-tufted. Integrated armrests are also upholstered in matching leather. The dark wood veneer of the plywood contrasts elegantly with the light brown leather and the black and silver star base.

name: Contemporary Boucle Swivel Barrel Chair
description: A modern, upholstered swivel chair featuring a rounded, barrel-back silhouette and a deeply cushioned seat, covered in a cream-colored, textured boucle fabric. It includes a small, rectangular throw pillow in a similar muted tone and rests on a low-profile, wood-finish swivel base, allowing for 360-degree rotation.

name: White Melamine Open Bookcase with Adjustable Shelves
description: A tall, narrow white bookcase featuring five open shelves, constructed from white melamine or laminate particle board. The shelves appear to be adjustable using pegs that fit into pre-drilled holes along the side panels.

name: Contemporary Two-Tone Floor Lamp with Conical Fabric Shade
description: A contemporary floor lamp featuring a sage green conical fabric shade atop a slender two-tone stem, combining a matte olive green finish with polished brass accents. The lamp is supported by a round, flat polished brass base, and includes a white power cord extending from the base. The design is minimalist and elegant.

name: Modern Contoured Wooden Bench
description: A modern bench featuring a distinctively contoured, wavy seat made from dark reddish-brown wood. The bench has a minimalist design with integrated rectangular legs, forming a single, seamless structure.

name: Ornate Bronze Accent Table with Twisted Column Legs
description: An ornate accent table featuring a round, flat top with a studded edge, supported by four distinctive twisted column legs. The legs converge at an X-shaped cross-stretcher base, adorned with a central brass finial and brass bun feet. The entire piece has a dark metallic, possibly bronze or antique brass, finish.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Square Coffee Table with Turned Legs and Lower Shelf
description: A traditional square coffee table crafted from dark stained wood, featuring a prominent tabletop and a lower storage shelf. The table is supported by four ornate turned legs that taper to small feet, showcasing a classic design aesthetic.

name: Low-Profile Round Pedestal Coffee Table
description: A contemporary low-profile round coffee table featuring a dark stained wood finish. Its substantial circular top rests upon a concealed central pedestal and two smaller, rounded support feet, contributing to its monolithic and grounded appearance.

name: Minimalist Beige Oval Bench with Cylindrical Legs
description: A minimalist, modern bench featuring an elongated oval top and three thick, cylindrical legs with rounded bases, all rendered in a matte beige finish. The design emphasizes soft curves and a monolithic appearance.

name: Contemporary Close-Coupled Ceramic Toilet
description: A modern, white ceramic close-coupled toilet with a sleek, minimalist design. It features a square-shaped pan and cistern, with a matching white soft-close toilet seat. The overall appearance is clean and contemporary.

name: Modern Two-Seater Fabric Sofa with Wood Arms
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring light-colored textured fabric upholstery, dark wood armrests that curve upwards and around the back, and low-profile dark wood legs. It includes two large seat cushions, two back cushions, and two smaller dark brown faux leather accent pillows.

name: Mid-Century Modern Button-Tufted Lounge Chair
description: A high-back upholstered lounge chair featuring button tufting, a contoured seat and back, and splayed wooden legs. The upholstery is a muted taupe color, indicative of a modern or mid-century aesthetic.

name: Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair with Headrest
description: A modern ergonomic office chair in black, featuring a breathable mesh backrest and adjustable headrest, a padded fabric seat, and a five-star wheeled base. It has adjustable armrests and seat height adjustment levers.

name: Modern Spiral Walnut and Glass Display Shelving Unit with Integrated Lighting
description: A tall, modern, freestanding spiral shelving unit featuring a dark walnut-toned wooden frame and five round, clear glass shelves. The wooden structure twists upwards in a continuous helix, with integrated LED lighting running along its inner edge, illuminating the shelves. The unit stands on a stable circular wooden base.

name: Upholstered Channel-Tufted Bed Frame
description: A modern upholstered bed frame featuring a distinctive channel-tufted design on the headboard, footboard, and side rails. The frame is finished in a light gray fabric and includes a wooden slat system for mattress support, eliminating the need for a box spring.

name: Organic Shape Wood Coffee Table
description: A low-profile coffee table featuring an organic, biomorphic tabletop shape and thick, rounded edges. The table is crafted from wood with a visible grain, finished in a muted gray-brown tone. It is supported by four robust, cylindrical legs that blend seamlessly with the table's overall chunky aesthetic. The design emphasizes natural, fluid lines, giving it a contemporary and sculptural feel.

name: Modern Rounded Oak and Stone Nightstand
description: A compact, modern nightstand or bedside cabinet featuring a light-toned oak wood body. It has a square top with gently rounded corners, appearing to be made of a light stone like travertine. The upper section contains a single drawer or door with a subtle, recessed brass or gold-toned handle. The base is a solid, architectural wooden structure, creating a robust pedestal-like form. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Contemporary Swivel Armchair with Barrel Back
description: A contemporary swivel lounge chair with a barrel-style back and integrated arms, upholstered in a rich, rust-colored velvet fabric. The chair features curved wooden panels on the inner arms and rests on a solid cylindrical wooden base, suggesting a swivel mechanism.

name: Modern Wooden Sofa with Integrated Glass-Top Armrests and Decorative Storage
description: A modern two-seater wooden sofa featuring a robust rectangular frame. The light beige seat and back cushions provide comfort, complemented by two throw pillows. The armrests are designed with integrated glass-topped surfaces, serving as practical side tables. One armrest also incorporates a storage unit with multiple open cubbies. The wooden frame is adorned with intricate, laser-cut or carved decorative panels on the exterior of the armrests and above the storage section, adding an elegant, geometric detail.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Chest of Drawers with Antiqued Brass Hardware
description: A traditional-style chest of drawers crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring five drawers arranged with two smaller ones at the top and three larger ones below. Each drawer front is accented with subtle molding, and they are fitted with antiqued brass knob pulls. The chest stands on four turned bun feet, and its base has a gently curved apron, contributing to its classic aesthetic. The overall finish is a deep, rich brown with visible wood grain.

name: Colonial Style Carved Wood and Cane Daybed
description: An intricately designed colonial-style daybed featuring a dark wood frame with detailed carvings and cane webbing panels. The daybed includes a light-colored upholstered cushion serving as the main mattress, complemented by two cylindrical bolster cushions adorned with a red and cream floral or geometric pattern. The wooden legs are turned and feature brass ferrules, contributing to its traditional aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Armless Upholstered Dining Chair
description: An armless dining chair featuring a dark wood frame and fully upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery is a light beige textured fabric. The backrest has a gentle curve and rounded top, while the legs are straight and slightly tapered, extending from the seat base. The chair exhibits clean, minimalist lines suitable for modern or transitional interiors.

name: Traditional Oak Trestle Dining Table
description: A traditional rectangular dining table crafted from light-colored wood, likely oak, featuring a trestle base. The tabletop has rounded corners and a smooth, polished finish. The base consists of two turned pedestals, each supported by two splayed, carved legs, all connected by a central horizontal stretcher bar.

name: Modern Sculptural Channel-Tufted Velvet Sofa with Integrated Wood Surfaces
description: A striking modular sofa featuring a fluid, undulating backrest and armrest, upholstered in ribbed olive-green velvet. The design incorporates flat, polished dark wood surfaces that serve as integrated side tables or display areas. The sofa consists of multiple segments, creating a long, organic form suitable for contemporary interiors.

name: Sculptural Organic Floor Lamp with Fabric Shade
description: A tall, slender floor lamp featuring an organically shaped stem that transitions from a dark, root-like base to a golden, branch-like upper section, topped with a white fabric lampshade. The base is a dark rectangular plinth.

name: Contemporary Bent Plywood and Metal Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a single piece of bent light wood veneer forming the seat and back, supported by a minimalist tubular metal frame in a dark red color. The frame includes four straight legs and curved armrests that follow the contour of the seat. The chair exhibits a clean, modern aesthetic.

name: High-Back Wooden Armchair with Woven Rope Seat and Backrest
description: A high-back armchair constructed from dark wood with a distinct woven rope seat and backrest. The backrest features a striking checkered pattern of open spaces and tightly woven natural fiber sections. The chair has straight wooden armrests and a sturdy, minimalist frame.

name: Upholstered Platform Bed with Layered Bohemian Bedding
description: A low-profile upholstered platform bed is presented with a complete, layered bedding ensemble. The bed frame itself features a subtle beige fabric upholstery. The bedding includes a fitted sheet and duvet cover in a light teal shade, topped with a medium teal blanket. A large, intricately crocheted or knitted throw in a cream color with fringe accents is draped over the teal blanket. The pillows are arranged in layers, starting with two cream-colored shams with braided trim, followed by two solid teal pillows, a decorative teal pillow with an ornate pattern, and a cream and teal striped lumbar pillow. The overall aesthetic is clean and inviting.

name: Colonial Style Cane Seat Armchair
description: A dark wood armchair featuring a classic design with a woven cane seat and gently curved armrests. The backrest consists of vertical slats, and the chair frame is crafted from solid wood, suggesting a traditional or colonial aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Chunky Velvet Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair in a rich brown velvet fabric, characterized by its substantial, rounded, and monolithic silhouette. The design features a continuous back and armrest structure, creating a C-shaped profile that flows into thick, rounded legs. The seat cushion appears integrated into the overall form, providing a clean, cohesive appearance.

name: Modern Sculptural Tubular Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a distinctive sculptural design with thick, tubular, rounded elements that form the legs, armrests, and backrest. The entire chair is fully upholstered in a muted olive green fabric, giving it a monolithic and soft appearance. The seat is an integrated, circular upholstered cushion, contributing to the chair's overall plush and organic aesthetic.

name: Art Deco Macassar Ebony Radial Headboard Bed
description: A luxurious bed featuring a prominent semi-circular headboard crafted with a radial pattern of dark wood veneer, possibly Macassar ebony. The low-profile platform bed frame also utilizes matching dark wood veneer with a vertical grain. The mattress and bolster pillows are upholstered in a distinctive brown and beige animal print fabric, resembling tiger stripes, contributing to an overall Art Deco or Hollywood Regency aesthetic.

name: Classic Upholstered Armchair with Nailhead Trim
description: A classic-style armchair featuring a dark wood frame with a curved top rail and a distinctive semi-circular cutout. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric, accented by extensive nailhead trim along the edges. The chair includes padded armrests integrated into the wooden frame, and the back of the backrest features a subtle decorative pattern in a similar muted tone.

name: Modern Wooden Armchair with Woven Backrest
description: A modern armchair constructed with a light-colored solid wood frame, featuring a distinctive woven strap backrest and a padded, upholstered seat. The chair has integrated armrests and four tapered legs, presenting a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Woven Ribbed Corduroy Cube Ottoman
description: A cube-shaped upholstered ottoman featuring a distinctive woven design created from wide, interlocking strips of ribbed corduroy fabric. The fabric is a warm terracotta or burnt orange color, and the ottoman rests on small, dark, low-profile feet.

name: Contemporary Grey Fabric Sofa with Sculptural Wood Frame
description: A modern two-seater sofa featuring light grey fabric upholstery, distinctive curved light wood armrests that seamlessly integrate with the backrest, and a minimalist brass-finished metal base. It is accompanied by four accent throw pillows in varying shades of grey and black.

name: Upholstered Armless Dining Chair with Metal Frame
description: An armless dining chair featuring light-colored, textured upholstery and a minimalist dark metal frame. The seat and backrest are amply padded, with the backrest presenting a gentle curve for ergonomic support. The four sturdy metal legs provide stable support.

name: Tiered Brass and Glass Rod Chandelier
description: A multi-tiered chandelier featuring a circular, gold-toned metal frame adorned with numerous vertical glass rods. The design consists of three concentric rings, each progressively smaller towards the bottom, creating a cascading effect. The glass rods are clear, allowing light to pass through and refract, suggesting a luminous and elegant fixture.

name: Upholstered Scalloped Accent Chair with Stacked Ball Legs
description: An exquisitely designed accent chair, characterized by its distinctive scalloped edges and unique stacked ball legs. The high backrest and the chair's body are upholstered in a rich red jacquard fabric with a gold/beige floral pattern, highlighted by deep red piping. The front features a wavy, scalloped skirt detail. The circular seat cushion is upholstered in plain, deep maroon velvet. The chair stands on four dark, polished wooden supports, each composed of a stack of four spherical elements.

name: Rustic Trestle Wooden Bench
description: A rustic-style wooden bench featuring a rectangular top made of solid wood planks. The bench is supported by two X-shaped trestle bases, which are connected by a horizontal stretcher bar for added stability. The wood has a natural, light brown finish with visible grain, suggesting a robust and durable construction. The design is simple and functional, leaning towards a farmhouse or contemporary rustic aesthetic.

name: Distressed Brown Leather Industrial Sofa
description: A long, three-seater sofa upholstered in distressed brown leather, featuring a minimalist gold-finished metal frame and slender legs. The sofa has rounded, integrated armrests and an integrated backrest with horizontal seaming. A distinctive external metal bar detail is visible on one arm. Two reddish-brown velvet throw pillows are included.
